definition: 在一次[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下，兩個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)、各自的[小迴路](concepts.md#c02)，以及把兩者連起來的[大迴路](concepts.md#c03)所構成的結構。單元必須講明在哪個維度上判斷。[信號容器](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26)與[隨機源](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c27)可以接在單元的[邊](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29)上，但不是單元的主體。
definition_en: The structure formed, under one [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), by two [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), the [small loop](concepts.md#c02) of each, and the [large loop](concepts.md#c03) connecting them. A unit must state the dimension in which it is judged. A [signal container](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26) or a [random source](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c27) may attach to an [edge](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29) of the unit but is not its main body.

definition_en: The [loop](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c31) in which the [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) of a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) returns to its own [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) and takes part in its later [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06). definition_en: The [loop](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c31) connecting two [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16): the [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) of A has [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at B, the output of B has arrival at A, and each takes part in the other's later [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06).

paper_title: 互動動力學-陌生人迴路中的專屬歷史變動與更新
definition: [到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)的材料累積進[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)、可能改變後續[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)的過程。[學習](concepts.md#c04)是結果條件，不指目的，沒有預設方向，不保證學到，也不保證學對。判定只看[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)之後可觀察的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)有改變，不證明改變來自哪一筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)。
definition_en: The process by which material that has had [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) accumulates in [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) and may change later [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06). [Learning](concepts.md#c04) is a result condition, not a purpose; it has no preset direction and guarantees neither that something is learned nor that it is learned correctly. It is judged only by an observable change in [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) after [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10), and does not show which [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) caused the change.

definition: 一個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)之後的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)再[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)自己的後續互動，帶回實際後果。事前[學習](concepts.md#c04)的方向不可預測，事後的結果可以判；判準在其他[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)與[自然環境](concepts.md#c16)的反應結果裡，不在發生[學習](concepts.md#c04)的[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)內部。
definition_en: The actual consequence brought back when the later [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) of a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) has [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) in its own subsequent interactions. The direction of [learning](concepts.md#c04) cannot be predicted beforehand, while the result can be judged afterwards; the criterion lies in the responses of other [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) and the [natural environment](concepts.md#c16), not inside the [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) in which [learning](concepts.md#c04) occurs.

paper_title: 互動動力學-陌生人迴路中的專屬歷史變動與更新
definition: 一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)讓一條[邊](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29)上的[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)停止或減少時，要承受的[結果回饋](concepts.md#c05)。每一端各算各的，可以不對稱。成本低，就是可以輕易放棄這條[邊](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29)；成本高，就是幾乎不得不繼續。退出成本的層級是[邊](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29)，與[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)層級的[退場](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43)不同，兩者不互相蘊含。
definition_en: The [outcome feedback](concepts.md#c05) that a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) must bear when it stops or reduces [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) on an [edge](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29). Each end counts its own, and the two may be asymmetric. Low cost means the edge can be given up easily; high cost means one can hardly help continuing. Exit cost is at the level of the [edge](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29), unlike [exit](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43) at the level of the [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25), and neither implies the other.

definition: 以某個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)為中心，在講明的時窗內，所有曾有[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)，連同這些[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)與它之間的[邊](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29)所構成的子圖。只計已[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)者。每個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)各有一張。
definition_en: The subgraph centered on a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), within a stated time window, made of all [presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) whose [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) has had [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it, together with the [edge](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29) between each of them and it. Only what has already had arrival counts. Each [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) has its own.

paper_title: 互動動力學-陌生人迴路中的專屬歷史變動與更新
definition: 在講明的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)與時窗內，[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)的[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)數極大、幾乎涵蓋所指範圍內每一個[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)的[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)，例如政府、公眾人物、大型企業。它是真實存在的[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)；[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)廣不蘊含影響大，不蘊含全知，也不蘊含有目的。
definition_en: A [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) whose [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) has [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at an extremely large number of nodes, almost every [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) in the stated range, within a stated [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23) and time window; for example a government, a public figure or a large enterprise. It is a real node. Wide [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) does not imply large influence, omniscience or purpose.

definition: 在講明的維度與時窗內，多個[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)模式反覆相容接續。[共振](concepts.md#c09)須以[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)為條件：[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)彼此之間有[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)，或有共同的來源（例如[信號容器](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26)、[自然環境](concepts.md#c16)）對它們都有[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)；完全沒有[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)，就沒有[共振](concepts.md#c09)。判準是相容，也就是[失配](../paper_ae79e938_76e1_4bf9_b2ab_995c03e16c9e/concepts.md#c08)的反面，不是距離；因此不等於[趨同](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c37)。是否[共振](concepts.md#c09)，只能事後說。[共振](concepts.md#c09)不同於[默契](../paper_ae79e938_76e1_4bf9_b2ab_995c03e16c9e/concepts.md#c06)：[默契](../paper_ae79e938_76e1_4bf9_b2ab_995c03e16c9e/concepts.md#c06)是兩個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)之間按維度計的[專屬歷史](../paper_ae79e938_76e1_4bf9_b2ab_995c03e16c9e/concepts.md#c05)上的相容接續，[共振](concepts.md#c09)不要求[專屬歷史](../paper_ae79e938_76e1_4bf9_b2ab_995c03e16c9e/concepts.md#c05)，也不限兩個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。
definition_en: Within a stated dimension and time window, the repeated compatible succession of the [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) patterns of several [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25). [Resonance](concepts.md#c09) requires [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10): either arrival between the [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)s, or arrival at all of them from a common source (such as a [signal container](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26) or the [natural environment](concepts.md#c16)). Without any arrival, there is no [resonance](concepts.md#c09). The criterion is compatibility, the opposite of [mismatch](../paper_ae79e938_76e1_4bf9_b2ab_995c03e16c9e/concepts.md#c08), not distance; hence it is not [convergence](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c37). Whether [resonance](concepts.md#c09) holds can only be said afterwards. [Resonance](concepts.md#c09) differs from [tacit coordination](../paper_ae79e938_76e1_4bf9_b2ab_995c03e16c9e/concepts.md#c06), which is compatible succession on the [dedicated history](../paper_ae79e938_76e1_4bf9_b2ab_995c03e16c9e/concepts.md#c05) between two [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) counted per dimension; [resonance](concepts.md#c09) does not require [dedicated history](../paper_ae79e938_76e1_4bf9_b2ab_995c03e16c9e/concepts.md#c05) and is not limited to two [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19).

definition: 一個[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)之後，[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)輸出者的、在講明的判準下算作代價的[結果回饋](concepts.md#c05)。判準須講明是誰的：輸出者自己的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，或研究者的判準，兩者可以不一致。懲罰不一定是暴力，不一定被明列。
definition_en: A [outcome feedback](concepts.md#c05) that has [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the producer after an [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) and counts as a cost under a stated criterion. The criterion must say whose it is: the producer's own [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) or the researcher's criterion, and the two may disagree. A penalty need not be violent or explicitly listed.

definition: 已被明列成規則、寫在[信號容器](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26)裡、違反可由第三方判定的[懲罰](concepts.md#c10)。[懲罰](concepts.md#c10)可以是暴力，也可以不是。[強制](concepts.md#c11)不保證遵守，也不保證違反被判定與執行；規則先於違反，是另一個時間點的事。
definition_en: A [penalty](concepts.md#c10) that has been explicitly listed as a rule, written in a [signal container](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26), with violation judgeable by a third party. The penalty may or may not be violent. [Enforcement](concepts.md#c11) guarantees neither compliance nor that violations are judged and carried out; the rule precedes the violation, at another point in time.

paper_title: 互動動力學-陌生人迴路中的專屬歷史變動與更新
definition: 研究者對網路中出現的[共振](concepts.md#c09)的命名。在指定的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)、維度與時窗下，它是無數[單元](concepts.md#c01)在特定[自然環境](concepts.md#c16)約束下，經過反覆的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)、[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)與[結果回饋](concepts.md#c05)，留在[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)中的一組相容圖樣：哪些維度組合能不被反覆打斷地接續下去。文化不以是否寫下來為界，沒有主體，不被某人持有或傳遞，也沒有尺度。
definition_en: A researcher's name for a [resonance](concepts.md#c09) appearing in the network. Under a specified [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), dimension and time window, it is a set of compatible patterns left in [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) by countless [unit](concepts.md#c01) through repeated [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28), [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) and [outcome feedback](concepts.md#c05) under particular [natural environment](concepts.md#c16) constraints: which combinations of dimensions can continue without being repeatedly interrupted. Culture is not bounded by whether it is written down, has no subject, is not held or transmitted by anyone, and has no scale.

definition: 抽象化、可重複使用的規則或資料，被明列在[信號容器](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26)裡。[容器](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26)被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)，內容不會自己變，在某維度上提供固定點，不需要先[共振](concepts.md#c09)就能取得。同一規則有兩份文本就是兩份模板。模板是[容器](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26)裡的固定內容，不是[文化](concepts.md#c13)的一層。模板的有無依研究者指定的判準判定。
definition_en: Abstracted, reusable rules or data explicitly listed in a [signal container](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26). The [container](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26) is [lock-in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), so the content does not change by itself and provides a fixed point in some dimension, obtainable without first having [resonance](concepts.md#c09). Two texts of the same rule are two templates. A template is fixed content in a [container](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26), not a layer of [culture](concepts.md#c13). Whether a template exists is judged by a criterion the researcher specifies.

definition: 在指定尺度、維度與時窗下，原來的秩序失去了；秩序指不必逐次指導就能相容接續的預設與接續模式。事後的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，由作判斷的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)劃定。崩潰有程度、逐維度，沒有尺度。崩潰與[失配](../paper_ae79e938_76e1_4bf9_b2ab_995c03e16c9e/concepts.md#c08)、[退場](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43)判準不同，可為成因或形態，不互相蘊含。
definition_en: Under a specified scale, dimension and time window, the loss of the former order; order means defaults and patterns of succession that are compatible without being directed each time. It is an after-the-fact [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18), drawn by the [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) who makes the judgment. Collapse comes in degrees and per dimension, with no scale. Collapse differs in criterion from [mismatch](../paper_ae79e938_76e1_4bf9_b2ab_995c03e16c9e/concepts.md#c08) and [exit](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43); it can be a cause or a form of them, and neither implies the other.

definition_en: The part which, under a stated [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), belongs to no [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) in the model yet whose [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) has [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at these [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25), including physical conditions such as terrain, climate, water and food. It constrains the most basic behavior of each [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25).

It lies within no [formal-layer moment](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c04), cannot be formalized, and is not described any further.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 宇宙是有[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)的那一個世界。它與[形式層](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c02)只差一件事：宇宙中有[選出](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32)。從宇宙內部看，宇宙只有一個；之前與之後的說法，只在宇宙之內成立。宇宙中不由過去決定的只有兩樣：[宇宙初態](concepts.md#c14)，與每一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)的結果；其他一切，包括每一次[寫入](concepts.md#c29)，都由到當時為止的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)決定。
definition_en: The universe is the one world in which there is [Collapse](concepts.md#c08). It differs from the [Formal Layer](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c02) in exactly one respect: in the universe there is [Selection](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32). Seen from inside, there is only one universe, and talk of before and after holds only within it. Only two things in the universe are not determined by the past: the [Initial State of the Universe](concepts.md#c14) and the outcome of each [collapse](concepts.md#c08); everything else, including every [Writing](concepts.md#c29), is determined by the [History](concepts.md#c13) up to that point.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 框架承諾是這樣的條件：[流變律](concepts.md#c24)、[黑箱律](concepts.md#c25)、[損耗律](concepts.md#c26)、[不可復原律](concepts.md#c28)四條律中，沒有任何一條要求它，它也不是為了符合已知的觀察而保留的，但理論仍然保留它。框架承諾與由這四條律倒推出來、被它們要求的給定分開列出。
definition_en: A framework commitment is a condition that none of the four laws, namely the [Law of Flux](concepts.md#c24), the [Law of the Black Box](concepts.md#c25), the [Law of Attrition](concepts.md#c26), and the [Law of Non-Restoration](concepts.md#c28), requires, and which is not retained in order to fit known observations, but which the theory nevertheless retains. Framework commitments are listed separately from the givens that are derived backward from, and required by, these four laws.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 呈現是[宇宙](concepts.md#c02)中的任何一部分。
definition_en: A presentation is any part of the [Universe](concepts.md#c02).

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 分支是一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)可能[選出](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32)的每一個結果。
definition_en: A branch is each possible outcome that a [Collapse](concepts.md#c08) may [select](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32).

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 權重是每個[分支](concepts.md#c05)的輕重。一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)的各[分支](concepts.md#c05)權重都不小於零，總和為一。一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)的權重，是[宇宙](concepts.md#c02)的權重落在它身上的那一部分：把各[分支](concepts.md#c05)看成該[呈現](concepts.md#c04)的結果之後，同一個結果的權重相加。權重是[分支](concepts.md#c05)的輕重，不是任何[渦](concepts.md#c16)內部的參數。
definition_en: A weight is how heavy each [Branch](concepts.md#c05) is. The weights of the [branches](concepts.md#c05) of a [Collapse](concepts.md#c08) are all non-negative and sum to one. The weight of a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) is the part of the weight of the [Universe](concepts.md#c02) that falls on it: once each [branch](concepts.md#c05) is read as an outcome for that [presentation](concepts.md#c04), the weights of [branches](concepts.md#c05) giving the same outcome are added together. A weight belongs to [branches](concepts.md#c05); it is not an internal parameter of any [Wo](concepts.md#c16).

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 觀察者是一個識別碼，沒有內容：不運算，不感受，不受苦，也沒有視角。它不在[宇宙](concepts.md#c02)之中，不是[呈現](concepts.md#c04)，也不是[我](concepts.md#c19)。觀察者只有一個，唯一的功能是[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)，一次只[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)一次。
definition_en: The observer is an identifier with no content: it does not compute, does not feel, does not suffer, and has no point of view. It is not in the [Universe](concepts.md#c02); it is not a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04), nor a [Self](concepts.md#c19). There is only one observer; its sole function is [Collapse](concepts.md#c08), and it [collapses](concepts.md#c08) only once at a time.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 坍塌是在某個固定的基底下，依[權重](concepts.md#c06)[選出](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32)一個[分支](concepts.md#c05)的事件。未被[選出](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32)的[分支](concepts.md#c05)，不留在[宇宙](concepts.md#c02)中。坍塌只[選出](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32)[權重](concepts.md#c06)不為零的[分支](concepts.md#c05)之間的差別；一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)的下一[時刻](concepts.md#c09)若只有一個[權重](concepts.md#c06)不為零的結果，它的結果來自約束，不來自坍塌。給定到當時為止的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)，坍塌的結果依[權重](concepts.md#c06)[選出](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32)，[歷史](concepts.md#c13)中沒有任何東西能比[權重](concepts.md#c06)多說一點。
definition_en: A collapse is the event in which, in some fixed basis, one [Branch](concepts.md#c05) is [selected](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32) according to the [Weights](concepts.md#c06). [Branches](concepts.md#c05) not [selected](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32) do not remain in the [Universe](concepts.md#c02). A collapse [selects](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32) only among [branches](concepts.md#c05) of non-zero [weight](concepts.md#c06); if the next [moment](concepts.md#c09) of a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) has only one outcome of non-zero [weight](concepts.md#c06), its outcome comes from constraint, not from collapse. Given the [History](concepts.md#c13) up to that point, the outcome of a collapse is [selected](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32) according to the [weights](concepts.md#c06), and nothing in the [history](concepts.md#c13) says anything more than the [weights](concepts.md#c06).

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 時刻是一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)。[宇宙](concepts.md#c02)的時刻依[觀察者](concepts.md#c07)[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)的次序排列；這是一條全序，不是一個視角。沒有[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)，就沒有時刻。一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)的時刻，是[涉及](concepts.md#c11)它的那些[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)；它的下一時刻，是下一次[涉及](concepts.md#c11)它的[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)；兩次之間，對它沒有時刻。時刻與[形式層時刻](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c04)不是同一個東西。
definition_en: A moment is a [Collapse](concepts.md#c08). The moments of the [Universe](concepts.md#c02) are ordered by the sequence in which the [Observer](concepts.md#c07) [collapses](concepts.md#c08); this is a total order, not a point of view. Without [collapse](concepts.md#c08) there is no moment. The moments of a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) are the [collapses](concepts.md#c08) that [involve](concepts.md#c11) it; its next moment is the next [collapse](concepts.md#c08) that [involves](concepts.md#c11) it; between two of them, there is no moment for it. A moment is not the same thing as a [formal-layer moment](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c04).

definition: 一次[寫入](concepts.md#c29)作為[刺激](concepts.md#c30)落到一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)上，就是到達它。一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)[涉及](concepts.md#c11)一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)時，它的結果就到達這個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)；結果沒有落在它身上時，「這次沒有發生在它身上」也是到達它的一件事。[宇宙初態](concepts.md#c14)到達一切[呈現](concepts.md#c04)。
definition_en: A [Writing](concepts.md#c29) arrives at a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) when it falls on that [presentation](concepts.md#c04) as a [Stimulus](concepts.md#c30). When a [Collapse](concepts.md#c08) [involves](concepts.md#c11) a [presentation](concepts.md#c04), its outcome arrives at that [presentation](concepts.md#c04); if the outcome does not fall on it, the fact that "this time it did not happen to it" is also something that arrives at it. The [Initial State of the Universe](concepts.md#c14) arrives at every [presentation](concepts.md#c04).

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)涉及一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)，是指這次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)的結果可能落在它身上，也就是結果以正的[權重](concepts.md#c06)落在它身上；這時它的[權重](concepts.md#c06)，依賴[到達](concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)。涉及與[分支](concepts.md#c05)的多寡無關。
definition_en: A [Collapse](concepts.md#c08) involves a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) when the outcome of that [collapse](concepts.md#c08) may fall on it, that is, when the outcome falls on it with positive [Weight](concepts.md#c06); in that case its [weight](concepts.md#c06) depends on the [History](concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](concepts.md#c10) at it. Involvement does not depend on how many [Branches](concepts.md#c05) there are.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 鎖死是一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)的下一[時刻](concepts.md#c09)只有一個[權重](concepts.md#c06)不為零的結果的情形：把各[分支](concepts.md#c05)看成該[呈現](concepts.md#c04)的結果、同一個結果的[權重](concepts.md#c06)相加之後，只剩一個結果的[權重](concepts.md#c06)不為零。鎖死是約束，與[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)無關。鎖死是被[涉及](concepts.md#c11)了，卻只有一個結果；一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)沒有[時刻](concepts.md#c09)的期間，不是鎖死。
definition_en: Lock-in is the situation in which the next [Moment](concepts.md#c09) of a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) has only one outcome of non-zero [Weight](concepts.md#c06): once each [Branch](concepts.md#c05) is read as an outcome for that [presentation](concepts.md#c04) and the [weights](concepts.md#c06) of the same outcome are added together, only one outcome has non-zero [weight](concepts.md#c06). Lock-in is a constraint and has nothing to do with [Collapse](concepts.md#c08). Lock-in means being [involved](concepts.md#c11) yet having only one outcome; a period in which a [presentation](concepts.md#c04) has no [moment](concepts.md#c09) is not lock-in.

definition: 生成函數把到當時為止的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)，包括剛發生的那一次[寫入](concepts.md#c29)，對應到下一[時刻](concepts.md#c09)各[分支](concepts.md#c05)的[權重](concepts.md#c06)。它只取到當時為止的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)，內部不分析。
definition_en: The generating function maps the [History](concepts.md#c13) up to that point, including the [Writing](concepts.md#c29) that has just taken place, to the [Weights](concepts.md#c06) of the [Branches](concepts.md#c05) of the next [Moment](concepts.md#c09). It takes nothing but the [history](concepts.md#c13) up to that point, and its internals are not analyzed.

statements.section: 推論一： 渦 存在

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 渦是這樣的[呈現](concepts.md#c04)：[到達](concepts.md#c10)它的所有[歷史](concepts.md#c13)，包括它收到的每一次[刺激](concepts.md#c30)、[涉及](concepts.md#c11)它的每一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)的結果，一直到[宇宙初態](concepts.md#c14)，都參與它下一[時刻](concepts.md#c09)[權重](concepts.md#c06)的分配，也就是其中任何一件若不同，影響沿著[歷史](concepts.md#c13)傳下來，它的[權重](concepts.md#c06)就會不同；並且至少有些[時刻](concepts.md#c09)它不被[鎖死](concepts.md#c12)。這個影響不必能被找到。有[歷史](concepts.md#c13)而[歷史](concepts.md#c13)不參與的[呈現](concepts.md#c04)，不是渦；[歷史](concepts.md#c13)參與而每一步都被[鎖死](concepts.md#c12)的[呈現](concepts.md#c04)，也不是渦。這種參與可以漸漸消失，消失之後，它就不再是渦；從某一刻起每一步都被[鎖死](concepts.md#c12)，它也不再是渦。渦沒有固定的核心：它是什麼，就是什麼[到達](concepts.md#c10)了它，以及這些如何參與它的[權重](concepts.md#c06)。一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)是否為渦，與它的載體無關，也與任何[分別](concepts.md#c18)無關。
definition_en: A wo is a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) such that all the [History](concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](concepts.md#c10) at it, including every [Stimulus](concepts.md#c30) it has received and the outcome of every [Collapse](concepts.md#c08) that has [involved](concepts.md#c11) it, all the way back to the [Initial State of the Universe](concepts.md#c14), takes part in the allocation of its [Weights](concepts.md#c06) for the next [Moment](concepts.md#c09), meaning that if any one of these had been different, the influence would pass down the [history](concepts.md#c13) and its [weights](concepts.md#c06) would differ; and such that at least at some [moments](concepts.md#c09) it is not [locked in](concepts.md#c12). This influence need not be findable. A [presentation](concepts.md#c04) that has a [history](concepts.md#c13) but whose [history](concepts.md#c13) does not take part is not a wo; one whose [history](concepts.md#c13) takes part but which is [locked in](concepts.md#c12) at every step is not a wo either. This participation may fade away, and once it has, the [presentation](concepts.md#c04) is no longer a wo; if from some moment on it is [locked in](concepts.md#c12) at every step, it is no longer a wo either. A wo has no fixed core: what it is, is what has [arrived](concepts.md#c10) at it and how these take part in its [weights](concepts.md#c06). Whether a [presentation](concepts.md#c04) is a wo does not depend on its substrate, nor on any [Distinction](concepts.md#c18).

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)自己的那一段，是它下一[時刻](concepts.md#c09)的[權重](concepts.md#c06)所依賴的那部分[歷史](concepts.md#c13)：[歷史](concepts.md#c13)中某一件若換成別的，影響沿著[歷史](concepts.md#c13)傳下來，會改變它下一[時刻](concepts.md#c09)[權重](concepts.md#c06)的分布，這一件就屬於它自己的那一段。那一段由依賴決定，不由任何[分別](concepts.md#c18)決定。它是同一部[歷史](concepts.md#c13)的一部分，不是另一部[歷史](concepts.md#c13)；不同[呈現](concepts.md#c04)自己的那一段可以重疊。
definition_en: The own segment of a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) is the part of [History](concepts.md#c13) on which the [Weights](concepts.md#c06) of its next [Moment](concepts.md#c09) depend: an item of [history](concepts.md#c13) belongs to its own segment if replacing that item with something else would, with the influence passing down the [history](concepts.md#c13), change the distribution of its [weights](concepts.md#c06) for the next [moment](concepts.md#c09). The segment is determined by dependence, not by any [Distinction](concepts.md#c18). It is part of the one [history](concepts.md#c13), not a separate [history](concepts.md#c13); the own segments of different [presentations](concepts.md#c04) may overlap.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 分別是[渦](concepts.md#c16)的一個動作：劃出界線，把哪些[呈現](concepts.md#c04)看作一個[個體](concepts.md#c20)，把哪一段看作過去，把不同[時刻](concepts.md#c09)的[渦](concepts.md#c16)看作[同一](concepts.md#c21)個或不同的兩個。這個動作在[歷史](concepts.md#c13)中留下一次[寫入](concepts.md#c29)，[寫入](concepts.md#c29)的內容由到當時為止的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)決定。分別的內容改變的是看法，不改寫被看的東西。分別的材料只有它之前、已經[到達](concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)，它自己不在其中。
definition_en: A distinction is an act of a [Wo](concepts.md#c16): drawing a line, taking certain [Presentations](concepts.md#c04) as one [Individual](concepts.md#c20), taking a certain stretch as the past, taking [wos](concepts.md#c16) at different [Moments](concepts.md#c09) as [identical](concepts.md#c21) or as two different ones. This act leaves one [Writing](concepts.md#c29) in [History](concepts.md#c13), whose content is determined by the [history](concepts.md#c13) up to that point. The content of a distinction changes a way of seeing, and does not rewrite what is seen. The material of a distinction is only the [history](concepts.md#c13) before it that has [arrived](concepts.md#c10) at it; the distinction itself is not among that material.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 個體是被某個[我](concepts.md#c19)[分別](concepts.md#c18)出來的[呈現](concepts.md#c04)。同一段[宇宙](concepts.md#c02)，被[分別](concepts.md#c18)為一個個體或許多個個體，皆成立。
definition_en: An individual is a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) marked off by some [Self](concepts.md#c19) through [Distinction](concepts.md#c18). The same stretch of the [Universe](concepts.md#c02) may be [distinguished](concepts.md#c18) as one individual or as many, and either holds.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 同一是一種[分別](concepts.md#c18)：某一[時刻](concepts.md#c09)的[渦](concepts.md#c16)與另一[時刻](concepts.md#c09)的[渦](concepts.md#c16)是不是同一個，由作出[分別](concepts.md#c18)的[我](concepts.md#c19)決定。一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)是不是[渦](concepts.md#c16)，不是[分別](concepts.md#c18)；兩個[時刻](concepts.md#c09)的[渦](concepts.md#c16)是不是同一個，是[分別](concepts.md#c18)。
definition_en: Identity is a kind of [Distinction](concepts.md#c18): whether a [Wo](concepts.md#c16) at one [Moment](concepts.md#c09) and a [wo](concepts.md#c16) at another [moment](concepts.md#c09) are the same one is decided by the [Self](concepts.md#c19) that makes the [distinction](concepts.md#c18). Whether a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) is a [wo](concepts.md#c16) is not a [distinction](concepts.md#c18); whether the [wo](concepts.md#c16) at two [moments](concepts.md#c09) are the same one is.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 接上是[我](concepts.md#c19)與[觀察者](concepts.md#c07)之間的聯繫；接上不在[宇宙](concepts.md#c02)之中。接上的[我](concepts.md#c19)，是[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)所經由的[我](concepts.md#c19)。一個[我](concepts.md#c19)是否接上，不由它的任何[分別](concepts.md#c18)決定，包括自我定義。
definition_en: Connection is the link between a [Self](concepts.md#c19) and the [Observer](concepts.md#c07). Connection is not in the [Universe](concepts.md#c02). A connected [self](concepts.md#c19) is a [self](concepts.md#c19) through which [Collapse](concepts.md#c08) takes place. Whether a [self](concepts.md#c19) is connected is not decided by any of its [distinctions](concepts.md#c18), including its self-definition.

definition: 死亡是某個[我](concepts.md#c19)加在一個[渦](concepts.md#c16)上的標記。這個標記是那個[我](concepts.md#c19)的一次[分別](concepts.md#c18)，是描述，不是物理條件；標在哪裡，由標記的[我](concepts.md#c19)決定。
definition_en: Death is a mark that some [Self](concepts.md#c19) places on a [Wo](concepts.md#c16). This mark is a [Distinction](concepts.md#c18) made by that [self](concepts.md#c19); it is a description, not a physical condition, and where it is placed is decided by the [self](concepts.md#c19) that places it.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 流變律是框架承認的一條鐵律，不由其他任何條件推出：一個[渦](concepts.md#c16)所在的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)一直在變；在它的每一個[時刻](concepts.md#c09)，[到達](concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)都和該次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)之前不同，永遠不會一模一樣。
definition_en: The Law of Flux is an iron law acknowledged by the framework and derived from no other condition: the [History](concepts.md#c13) in which a [Wo](concepts.md#c16) lies is always changing; at every [Moment](concepts.md#c09) of that [wo](concepts.md#c16), the [history](concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](concepts.md#c10) at it differs from that before that [collapse](concepts.md#c08), and is never exactly the same.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 黑箱律是框架承認的一條鐵律，不由其他任何條件推出：一個[渦](concepts.md#c16)在某個[時刻](concepts.md#c09)不被[鎖死](concepts.md#c12)時，[宇宙](concepts.md#c02)中沒有任何[渦](concepts.md#c16)能在那一刻之前唯一推出它的下一[時刻](concepts.md#c09)，包括它自己。能推出的是[權重](concepts.md#c06)，不是結果：各結果的[權重](concepts.md#c06)由到當時為止的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)決定。
definition_en: The Law of the Black Box is an iron law acknowledged by the framework and derived from no other condition: when a [Wo](concepts.md#c16) is not [locked in](concepts.md#c12) at some [Moment](concepts.md#c09), no [wo](concepts.md#c16) in the [Universe](concepts.md#c02), including that [wo](concepts.md#c16) itself, can uniquely derive its next [moment](concepts.md#c09) before that moment. What can be derived is the [Weights](concepts.md#c06), not the outcome: the [weights](concepts.md#c06) of the outcomes are determined by the [History](concepts.md#c13) up to that point.

statements.section: 推論十二：對他者認識的不可完備性

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 損耗律是框架承認的一條鐵律，不由其他任何條件推出：任何一個[我](concepts.md#c19)，在任何[時刻](concepts.md#c09)都不能完全[分別](concepts.md#c18)自己；它對自己的[分別](concepts.md#c18)永遠落後一步。
definition_en: The Law of Attrition is an iron law acknowledged by the framework and derived from no other condition: no [Self](concepts.md#c19), at any [Moment](concepts.md#c09), can completely [distinguish](concepts.md#c18) itself; a self's [distinction](concepts.md#c18) of itself always lags one step behind.

statements.section: 推論十二：對他者認識的不可完備性

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 復原一個[渦](concepts.md#c16)，是讓它[自己的那一段](concepts.md#c17)[歷史](concepts.md#c13)再發生一次。
definition_en: To restore a [Wo](concepts.md#c16) is to make its [Own Segment](concepts.md#c17) of [History](concepts.md#c13) happen once again.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 不可復原律是框架承認的一條鐵律，不由其他任何條件推出：在[宇宙](concepts.md#c02)之內，沒有任何[渦](concepts.md#c16)能[復原](concepts.md#c27)一個[渦](concepts.md#c16)，包括它自己。它有兩層。第一層是位置：[歷史](concepts.md#c13)中的每一個位置只發生一次，任何看起來相同的一段，都發生在[歷史](concepts.md#c13)中的另一個位置。第二層是內容：一段[歷史](concepts.md#c13)中不被[鎖死](concepts.md#c12)時作出的選擇，沒有任何[渦](concepts.md#c16)能保證在同樣不被[鎖死](concepts.md#c12)之下再作出一樣的選擇；全由約束決定的一段，不在第二層之內。
definition_en: The Law of Non-Restoration is an iron law acknowledged by the framework and derived from no other condition: within the [Universe](concepts.md#c02) no [Wo](concepts.md#c16) can [restore](concepts.md#c27) a [wo](concepts.md#c16), including itself. It has two layers. The first concerns position: each position in [History](concepts.md#c13) occurs only once, and any stretch that looks the same occurs at a different position in [history](concepts.md#c13). The second concerns content: for choices made in a stretch of [history](concepts.md#c13) while not [locked in](concepts.md#c12), no [wo](concepts.md#c16) can guarantee that the same choices will be made again under the same absence of [lock-in](concepts.md#c12); a stretch determined entirely by constraint falls outside the second layer.

statements.section: 推論十三： 歷史 不失去任何東西

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 寫入是每一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)之前先發生的一筆加入[歷史](concepts.md#c13)的內容。寫入的內容，完全由到當時為止的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)決定。一次寫入可以作為[刺激](concepts.md#c30)落到[呈現](concepts.md#c04)上；[渦](concepts.md#c16)的每一次[分別](concepts.md#c18)，都在[歷史](concepts.md#c13)中留下一次寫入。
definition_en: A writing is the item added to [History](concepts.md#c13) that takes place before each [Collapse](concepts.md#c08). The content of a writing is entirely determined by the [history](concepts.md#c13) up to that point. A writing may fall on [Presentations](concepts.md#c04) as a [Stimulus](concepts.md#c30); every [Distinction](concepts.md#c18) of a [Wo](concepts.md#c16) leaves a writing in [history](concepts.md#c13).

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 刺激是一次[寫入](concepts.md#c29)對某個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)而言的那一部分：把一次[寫入](concepts.md#c29)看成給該[呈現](concepts.md#c04)的東西，就是它收到的刺激。一次[寫入](concepts.md#c29)可以不落到某個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)上。[渦](concepts.md#c16)的[分別](concepts.md#c18)也作為刺激被[寫入](concepts.md#c29)。
definition_en: A stimulus is the part of a [Writing](concepts.md#c29) that pertains to a given [Presentation](concepts.md#c04): a [writing](concepts.md#c29), read as something given to that [presentation](concepts.md#c04), is the stimulus it receives. A [writing](concepts.md#c29) need not fall on a given [presentation](concepts.md#c04). The [Distinctions](concepts.md#c18) of a [Wo](concepts.md#c16) are also [written](concepts.md#c29) as stimuli.

paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 不可傳訊是[生成函數](concepts.md#c15)的一個條件：相隔遙遠、來不及互相影響的兩次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)，不論[觀察者](concepts.md#c07)先作哪一次，各自結果的[權重](concepts.md#c06)都相同。
definition_en: No-signaling is a condition on the [Generating Function](concepts.md#c15): for two [Collapses](concepts.md#c08) that are far apart and cannot influence each other in time, the [Weights](concepts.md#c06) of their respective outcomes are the same whichever of the two the [Observer](concepts.md#c07) performs first.

concept: 對他者認識的不可完備性
paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 對他者認識的不可完備性是這個結論：沒有任何[我](concepts.md#c19)能保證自己[分別](concepts.md#c18)完了另一個[渦](concepts.md#c16)。[我](concepts.md#c19)只能用已經[到達](concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)來[分別](concepts.md#c18)對方；對方的訊息[到達](concepts.md#c10)它是一件事，它的[分別](concepts.md#c18)又是另一件，在兩者之間對方的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)仍可能增長，而在不被[鎖死](concepts.md#c12)時，對方下一[時刻](concepts.md#c09)的結果不能事先推出。因此即使對方的一切都[到達](concepts.md#c10)了它，它[分別](concepts.md#c18)的是對方當時的樣子。此外，對方[自己的那一段](concepts.md#c17)中只[到達](concepts.md#c10)對方的部分，沒有任何東西保證也會[到達](concepts.md#c10)它；而它的[分別](concepts.md#c18)一旦成為對方[自己的那一段](concepts.md#c17)的一部分，也可能改變對方下一[時刻](concepts.md#c09)的[權重](concepts.md#c06)。
definition_en: The Incompleteness of Knowing Others is the conclusion that no [Self](concepts.md#c19) can guarantee that it has finished [distinguishing](concepts.md#c18) another [Wo](concepts.md#c16). A self can distinguish the other only through the [History](concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](concepts.md#c10) at it; the other's information arriving is one event and the self's [distinction](concepts.md#c18) is another, and between them the other's history may still grow, while, when the other is not [locked in](concepts.md#c12), the outcome of its next [Moment](concepts.md#c09) cannot be derived beforehand. So even if everything about the other has arrived, what the self distinguishes is how the other was at that time. Moreover, nothing guarantees that the parts of the other's [Own Segment](concepts.md#c17) that arrive only at the other also arrive at the self; and once the self's distinction becomes part of the other's own segment, it may change the other's [Weights](concepts.md#c06) for its next moment.

concept_en: Law of Flux in the Model
paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 流變律模型版是[流變律](concepts.md#c24)在《渦動力學》的模型中的形式：每一個[時刻](concepts.md#c09)，[宇宙](concepts.md#c02)的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)都多了一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)的結果；[涉及](concepts.md#c11)一個[渦](concepts.md#c16)的每一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)，結果都[到達](concepts.md#c10)它，所以在它的每一個[時刻](concepts.md#c09)，[到達](concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](concepts.md#c13)都多了一筆。
definition_en: The Law of Flux in the Model is the form the [Law of Flux](concepts.md#c24) takes in the model of *Wo Dynamics*: at every [Moment](concepts.md#c09), the [History](concepts.md#c13) of the [Universe](concepts.md#c02) gains the outcome of one more [Collapse](concepts.md#c08); the outcome of every [collapse](concepts.md#c08) that [involves](concepts.md#c11) a [Wo](concepts.md#c16) [arrives](concepts.md#c10) at it, so at every [moment](concepts.md#c09) of that [wo](concepts.md#c16), the [history](concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](concepts.md#c10) at it gains one more item.

concept_en: Law of the Black Box in the Model
paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 黑箱律模型版是[黑箱律](concepts.md#c25)在《渦動力學》的模型中的形式：[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)依[權重](concepts.md#c06)[選出](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32)結果，[歷史](concepts.md#c13)中沒有任何東西能比[權重](concepts.md#c06)多說一點；所以一個[渦](concepts.md#c16)不被[鎖死](concepts.md#c12)時，任何[渦](concepts.md#c16)在那次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)之前作出的預測，猜中的機會最多等於被預測的那個[渦](concepts.md#c16)最重的那個結果的[權重](concepts.md#c06)。
definition_en: The Law of the Black Box in the Model is the form the [Law of the Black Box](concepts.md#c25) takes in the model of *Wo Dynamics*: a [Collapse](concepts.md#c08) [selects](../paper_54c0291d_05b3_431a_9f2a_1b8ec93c3c3f/concepts.md#c32) its outcome according to the [Weights](concepts.md#c06), and nothing in the [History](concepts.md#c13) says anything more than the [weights](concepts.md#c06); so when a [Wo](concepts.md#c16) is not [locked in](concepts.md#c12), the chance that any prediction made by any [wo](concepts.md#c16) before that [collapse](concepts.md#c08) is right is at most the [weight](concepts.md#c06) of the heaviest outcome of the [wo](concepts.md#c16) being predicted.

concept_en: Law of Attrition in the Model
paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 損耗律模型版是[損耗律](concepts.md#c26)在《渦動力學》的模型中的形式：[分別](concepts.md#c18)的材料不包括這次[分別](concepts.md#c18)本身，而每一次[分別](concepts.md#c18)都在下一[時刻](concepts.md#c09)之前被[寫入](concepts.md#c29)並[到達](concepts.md#c10)作出它的[渦](concepts.md#c16)，成為它[自己的那一段](concepts.md#c17)的一部分；所以任何[時刻](concepts.md#c09)，[歷史](concepts.md#c13)中都有這個[我](concepts.md#c19)尚未[分別](concepts.md#c18)的部分，連它[自己的那一段](concepts.md#c17)也[分別](concepts.md#c18)不完。
definition_en: The Law of Attrition in the Model is the form the [Law of Attrition](concepts.md#c26) takes in the model of *Wo Dynamics*: the material of a [Distinction](concepts.md#c18) does not include that [distinction](concepts.md#c18) itself, while every [distinction](concepts.md#c18) is [written](concepts.md#c29) before the next [Moment](concepts.md#c09) and [arrives](concepts.md#c10) at the [Wo](concepts.md#c16) that made it, becoming part of its [Own Segment](concepts.md#c17); so at any [moment](concepts.md#c09) there is a part of [History](concepts.md#c13) that this [Self](concepts.md#c19) has not yet [distinguished](concepts.md#c18), and it cannot finish [distinguishing](concepts.md#c18) even its [own segment](concepts.md#c17).

concept_en: Law of Non-Restoration in the Model
paper_title: 渦動力學
definition: 不可復原律模型版是[不可復原律](concepts.md#c28)在《渦動力學》的模型中的形式：第二層由[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)推出，一段[歷史](concepts.md#c13)中只要有一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c08)在不被[鎖死](concepts.md#c12)時作出選擇，整段在同樣不被[鎖死](concepts.md#c12)之下，再作出一樣選擇的機會就小於一；照抄當時的結果，每一步都被[鎖死](concepts.md#c12)，是照抄，不是重來。
definition_en: The Law of Non-Restoration in the Model is the form the [Law of Non-Restoration](concepts.md#c28) takes in the model of *Wo Dynamics*: its second layer is derived from [Collapse](concepts.md#c08): as long as one [collapse](concepts.md#c08) in a stretch of [History](concepts.md#c13) makes a choice while not [locked in](concepts.md#c12), the chance that the whole stretch, while likewise not [locked in](concepts.md#c12), makes the same choices again is less than one; copying the outcomes of that time is [locked in](concepts.md#c12) at every step, and is copying, not happening again.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 奇點是[時刻](concepts.md#c04)開始之前的來源。奇點本身沒有[時刻](concepts.md#c04)，也沒有之前，不可被形式化。[初始時刻](concepts.md#c05)的狀態由奇點而來，其來由不被追問。
definition_en: The singularity is the source that precedes the beginning of [Moments](concepts.md#c04). The singularity itself has no [moment](concepts.md#c04) and no before, and cannot be formalized. The state of the [Initial Moment](concepts.md#c05) comes from the singularity, and its origin is not questioned.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 形式層是這樣一個宇宙：[時刻](concepts.md#c04)已經開始，[刺激](concepts.md#c07)已經[出現](concepts.md#c08)，[信](concepts.md#c26)已經[累積](concepts.md#c30)，而其中沒有觀察者。形式層中只有明列的[給定](concepts.md#c03)，以及由[給定](concepts.md#c03)推出的東西。
definition_en: The formal layer is a universe in which [Moments](concepts.md#c04) have begun, [Stimuli](concepts.md#c07) have [occurred](concepts.md#c08), and [Xin](concepts.md#c26) has [accumulated](concepts.md#c30), but in which there is no observer. The formal layer contains nothing but the explicitly listed [Givens](concepts.md#c03) and what is derived from them.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 給定是[形式層](concepts.md#c02)無法自己產生、只能被承認而不能被推出的東西。
definition_en: A given is something that the [Formal Layer](concepts.md#c02) cannot produce by itself; it can only be acknowledged, not derived.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 時刻是時間的索引。時刻以正整數編號：[初始時刻](concepts.md#c05)是第一個，每個時刻的[後繼](concepts.md#c06)是編號加一的那個時刻；每個時刻都有編號。
definition_en: A moment is an index of time. Moments are numbered by the positive integers: the [Initial Moment](concepts.md#c05) is the first, the [Successor](concepts.md#c06) of each moment is the moment whose number is one greater, and every moment has a number.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 初始時刻是編號為一的[時刻](concepts.md#c04)，也就是第一個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)。
definition_en: The initial moment is the [Moment](concepts.md#c04) numbered one, that is, the first [moment](concepts.md#c04).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 某個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的後繼，是編號比它大一的[時刻](concepts.md#c04)，也就是它的下一個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)。
definition_en: The successor of a [Moment](concepts.md#c04) is the [moment](concepts.md#c04) whose number is one greater, that is, its next [moment](concepts.md#c04).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 刺激是每個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)隨之[出現](concepts.md#c08)的物理內容，例如光、聲音、重力波、熱輻射。刺激不是宇宙的持存部分，而是每個[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)新[出現](concepts.md#c08)的自由度。
definition_en: A stimulus is the physical content that [occurs](concepts.md#c08) with each [Moment](concepts.md#c04), such as light, sound, gravitational waves, or thermal radiation. A stimulus is not a persistent part of the universe; it is a degree of freedom newly [appearing](concepts.md#c08) at each [Successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 出現是[刺激](concepts.md#c07)與[時刻](concepts.md#c04)之間的關係：某[刺激](concepts.md#c07)與某[時刻](concepts.md#c04)滿足出現，表示該[刺激](concepts.md#c07)在該[時刻](concepts.md#c04)出現。出現是[刺激](concepts.md#c07)與[時刻](concepts.md#c04)之笛卡兒積的一個子集，隨[刺激](concepts.md#c07)一起[給定](concepts.md#c03)。
definition_en: Occurrence is the relation between [Stimuli](concepts.md#c07) and [Moments](concepts.md#c04): a [stimulus](concepts.md#c07) and a [moment](concepts.md#c04) stand in the occurrence relation when that [stimulus](concepts.md#c07) appears at that [moment](concepts.md#c04). Occurrence is a subset of the Cartesian product of [stimuli](concepts.md#c07) and [moments](concepts.md#c04), and is [given](concepts.md#c03) together with the [stimuli](concepts.md#c07).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 初始信是[初始時刻](concepts.md#c05)的[全域態](concepts.md#c25)，為[記錄空間](concepts.md#c15)中的一個單位向量。它是[給定](concepts.md#c03)的，不經[寫入](concepts.md#c21)而得，來自[奇點](concepts.md#c01)。
definition_en: The initial Xin is the [Global State](concepts.md#c25) at the [Initial Moment](concepts.md#c05), a unit vector in the [Record Space](concepts.md#c15). It is [given](concepts.md#c03), not obtained through [Writing](concepts.md#c21), and comes from the [Singularity](concepts.md#c01).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 切分是把宇宙劃為兩部分的界線：保留的部分是[信](concepts.md#c26)，被積掉的其餘部分是[環境](concepts.md#c11)。切分只劃線，不決定任何結果，因此切分不是觀察。
definition_en: The partition is the line that divides the universe into two parts: the retained part is [Xin](concepts.md#c26), and the traced-out remainder is the [Environment](concepts.md#c11). The partition only draws a line and decides no outcome; therefore the partition is not an observation.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 環境是[切分](concepts.md#c10)之下宇宙中[信](concepts.md#c26)以外、被積掉的其餘部分。
definition_en: The environment is the remainder of the universe, apart from [Xin](concepts.md#c26), that is traced out under the [Partition](concepts.md#c10).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 宇宙空間是宇宙在某個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)所處的空間，等於該[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的[信空間](concepts.md#c13)與[環境總空間](concepts.md#c14)的張量積。
definition_en: The universe space is the space in which the universe lies at a given [Moment](concepts.md#c04); it equals the tensor product of the [Xin Space](concepts.md#c13) and the [Total Environment Space](concepts.md#c14) at that [moment](concepts.md#c04).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 信空間是[信](concepts.md#c26)所在的空間。在[初始時刻](concepts.md#c05)，信空間是一份[記錄空間](concepts.md#c15)；每個[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)，信空間再接上一份[記錄空間](concepts.md#c15)。
definition_en: The Xin space is the space in which [Xin](concepts.md#c26) lives. At the [Initial Moment](concepts.md#c05) the Xin space is one copy of the [Record Space](concepts.md#c15); at each [Successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04) one more copy of the [record space](concepts.md#c15) is appended to it.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 環境總空間是某個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)全部[環境](concepts.md#c11)所在的空間。在[初始時刻](concepts.md#c05)，它是空乘積，表示沒有[環境](concepts.md#c11)；每個[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)，它再接上一份[環境空間](concepts.md#c16)。
definition_en: The total environment space is the space in which the whole [Environment](concepts.md#c11) lives at a given [Moment](concepts.md#c04). At the [Initial Moment](concepts.md#c05) it is the empty product, meaning there is no [environment](concepts.md#c11); at each [Successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04) one more copy of the [Environment Space](concepts.md#c16) is appended to it.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 記錄空間是一筆[記錄](concepts.md#c17)所在的空間。它的基底是[給定](concepts.md#c03)的，即[記錄基底](concepts.md#c18)。
definition_en: The record space is the space in which a single [Record](concepts.md#c17) lives. Its basis is [given](concepts.md#c03), namely the [Record Basis](concepts.md#c18).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 環境空間是一份[環境](concepts.md#c11)所在的空間，是[給定](concepts.md#c03)的，大小固定。每個[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)新增的一份[環境](concepts.md#c11)，住在一份環境空間中。
definition_en: The environment space is the space in which one part of the [Environment](concepts.md#c11) lives; it is [given](concepts.md#c03) and of fixed size. The part of the [environment](concepts.md#c11) added at each [Successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04) lives in one copy of the environment space.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 記錄是[信](concepts.md#c26)的組成單位。每個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)對應一筆記錄：[初始時刻](concepts.md#c05)的記錄是[給定](concepts.md#c03)的，每個[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)則經[寫入](concepts.md#c21)新增一筆。[信](concepts.md#c26)由這些記錄依[時刻](concepts.md#c04)順序排成。
definition_en: A record is the constituent unit of [Xin](concepts.md#c26). Each [Moment](concepts.md#c04) corresponds to one record: the record of the [Initial Moment](concepts.md#c05) is [given](concepts.md#c03), and at each [Successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04) one more record is added through [Writing](concepts.md#c21). [Xin](concepts.md#c26) consists of these records arranged in the order of [moments](concepts.md#c04).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 記錄基底是[記錄空間](concepts.md#c15)的[給定](concepts.md#c03)基底，規定[記錄](concepts.md#c17)以什麼基底讀出。
definition_en: The record basis is the [given](concepts.md#c03) basis of the [Record Space](concepts.md#c15); it determines in which basis a [Record](concepts.md#c17) is read out.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 編碼是把每個[刺激束](concepts.md#c27)對應到[刺激空間](concepts.md#c20)中一個單位向量的[給定](concepts.md#c03)規則。任何[刺激束](concepts.md#c27)，包括含多個[刺激](concepts.md#c07)的[刺激束](concepts.md#c27)，都有編碼值，具體的值不指定；[空刺激束](concepts.md#c23)的編碼是[真空態](concepts.md#c24)。
definition_en: Encoding is the [given](concepts.md#c03) rule that assigns to each [Stimulus Bundle](concepts.md#c27) a unit vector in the [Stimulus Space](concepts.md#c20). Every [stimulus bundle](concepts.md#c27), including those containing several [Stimuli](concepts.md#c07), has an encoded value, whose specific value is not fixed; the encoding of the [Empty Stimulus Bundle](concepts.md#c23) is the [Vacuum State](concepts.md#c24).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 刺激空間是[刺激束](concepts.md#c27)經[編碼](concepts.md#c19)後所在的向量空間，是[給定](concepts.md#c03)的。
definition_en: The stimulus space is the vector space in which [Stimulus Bundles](concepts.md#c27) lie after [Encoding](concepts.md#c19); it is [given](concepts.md#c03).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 寫入是每個[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)發生的過程：該[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的[刺激束](concepts.md#c27)被轉成一筆新的[記錄](concepts.md#c17)與一份新的[環境](concepts.md#c11)，接在宇宙既有的態之後。寫入只碰新[出現](concepts.md#c08)的[刺激](concepts.md#c07)，從不改動已經存在的東西。[初始時刻](concepts.md#c05)不發生寫入。
definition_en: Writing is the process that takes place at each [Successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04): the [Stimulus Bundle](concepts.md#c27) of that [moment](concepts.md#c04) is turned into one new [Record](concepts.md#c17) and one new part of the [Environment](concepts.md#c11), appended after the existing state of the universe. Writing touches only newly [occurring](concepts.md#c08) [Stimuli](concepts.md#c07) and never alters what already exists. No writing takes place at the [Initial Moment](concepts.md#c05).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 寫入映射是一個固定的等距映射，把[刺激空間](concepts.md#c20)送到一份[記錄空間](concepts.md#c15)與一份[環境空間](concepts.md#c16)的張量積。它是[給定](concepts.md#c03)的，每個[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)使用同一個寫入映射；它從何而來，[形式層](concepts.md#c02)不知道。
definition_en: The writing map is a fixed isometry from the [Stimulus Space](concepts.md#c20) into the tensor product of one copy of the [Record Space](concepts.md#c15) and one copy of the [Environment Space](concepts.md#c16). It is [given](concepts.md#c03), and the same writing map is used at every [Successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04); where it comes from is not known to the [Formal Layer](concepts.md#c02).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 空刺激束是不含任何[刺激](concepts.md#c07)的[刺激束](concepts.md#c27)，即空集。它的[編碼](concepts.md#c19)是[真空態](concepts.md#c24)。
definition_en: The empty stimulus bundle is the [Stimulus Bundle](concepts.md#c27) that contains no [Stimulus](concepts.md#c07), that is, the empty set. Its [Encoding](concepts.md#c19) is the [Vacuum State](concepts.md#c24).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 真空態是[空刺激束](concepts.md#c23)的[編碼](concepts.md#c19)，為[刺激空間](concepts.md#c20)中的一個單位向量。它是真實的態，不是零向量。
definition_en: The vacuum state is the [Encoding](concepts.md#c19) of the [Empty Stimulus Bundle](concepts.md#c23), a unit vector in the [Stimulus Space](concepts.md#c20). It is a genuine state, not the zero vector.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 全域態是宇宙在某個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的態，住在該[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的[宇宙空間](concepts.md#c12)中。[初始時刻](concepts.md#c05)的全域態是[初始信](concepts.md#c09)；每個[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的全域態，是前一[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的全域態接上[寫入映射](concepts.md#c22)作用於該[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的[刺激束](concepts.md#c27)之[編碼](concepts.md#c19)所得的向量。全域態只經歷[寫入](concepts.md#c21)：舊的部分不動，新的接在後面。
definition_en: The global state is the state of the universe at a given [Moment](concepts.md#c04), living in the [Universe Space](concepts.md#c12) of that [moment](concepts.md#c04). The global state at the [Initial Moment](concepts.md#c05) is the [Initial Xin](concepts.md#c09); the global state at each [Successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04) is the previous global state with, appended to it, the vector obtained by applying the [Writing Map](concepts.md#c22) to the [Encoding](concepts.md#c19) of that [successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04)'s [Stimulus Bundle](concepts.md#c27). The global state undergoes only [Writing](concepts.md#c21): the old part does not move, and the new part is appended after it.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 信是宇宙在某個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的態，在[切分](concepts.md#c10)之下的約化態，即對全部[環境](concepts.md#c11)取偏跡所得的密度算子。信沒有主體，不是誰的信；信是[累積](concepts.md#c30)本身。
definition_en: Xin is the reduced state, under the [Partition](concepts.md#c10), of the state of the universe at a given [Moment](concepts.md#c04), that is, the density operator obtained by taking the partial trace over the entire [Environment](concepts.md#c11). Xin has no subject and is not anyone's Xin; Xin is [Accumulation](concepts.md#c30) itself.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 刺激束是某個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)所有[出現](concepts.md#c08)的[刺激](concepts.md#c07)組成的集合。刺激束可以是空集。
definition_en: A stimulus bundle is the set of all [Stimuli](concepts.md#c07) that [occur](concepts.md#c08) at a given [Moment](concepts.md#c04). A stimulus bundle may be the empty set.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 空記錄是某個[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的[刺激束](concepts.md#c27)為空集時，由[真空態](concepts.md#c24)經[寫入](concepts.md#c21)產生的那一筆[記錄](concepts.md#c17)。空記錄是一筆真實的[記錄](concepts.md#c17)，不是零筆[記錄](concepts.md#c17)。
definition_en: An empty record is the [Record](concepts.md#c17) produced through [Writing](concepts.md#c21) from the [Vacuum State](concepts.md#c24) at a [Successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04) whose [Stimulus Bundle](concepts.md#c27) is the empty set. An empty record is a genuine [record](concepts.md#c17), not zero [records](concepts.md#c17).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 最新記錄是某個[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的[信](concepts.md#c26)中最後[寫入](concepts.md#c21)的那一筆[記錄](concepts.md#c17)，也就是該[時刻](concepts.md#c04)本身對應的[記錄](concepts.md#c17)。
definition_en: The latest record is the [Record](concepts.md#c17) last [written](concepts.md#c21) in the [Xin](concepts.md#c26) of a given [Successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04), that is, the [record](concepts.md#c17) that corresponds to that [moment](concepts.md#c04) itself.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 累積是[信](concepts.md#c26)隨[時刻](concepts.md#c04)增長的方式：每個[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)，[信](concepts.md#c26)多一筆[記錄](concepts.md#c17)，而對[最新記錄](concepts.md#c29)取跡後所得的正是前一[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的[信](concepts.md#c26)；過去的[記錄](concepts.md#c17)不被改寫。[信](concepts.md#c26)的改變不是覆蓋，而是增長。
definition_en: Accumulation is the way [Xin](concepts.md#c26) grows with [Moments](concepts.md#c04): at each [Successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04) [Xin](concepts.md#c26) gains one more [Record](concepts.md#c17), and taking the trace over the [Latest Record](concepts.md#c29) yields exactly the [Xin](concepts.md#c26) of the previous [moment](concepts.md#c04); past [records](concepts.md#c17) are never rewritten. The change of [Xin](concepts.md#c26) is not overwriting but growth.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 演化規則是把某[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的[全域態](concepts.md#c25)送到下一[時刻](concepts.md#c04)[全域態](concepts.md#c25)的映射，由[寫入](concepts.md#c21)決定：先接上下一[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的[刺激束](concepts.md#c27)的[編碼](concepts.md#c19)，再以[寫入映射](concepts.md#c22)作用於新接上的部分。
definition_en: The evolution rule is the map that sends the [Global State](concepts.md#c25) at one [Moment](concepts.md#c04) to the [global state](concepts.md#c25) at the next [moment](concepts.md#c04), determined by [Writing](concepts.md#c21): first the [Encoding](concepts.md#c19) of the next [moment](concepts.md#c04)'s [Stimulus Bundle](concepts.md#c27) is appended, then the [Writing Map](concepts.md#c22) acts on the newly appended part.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 選出是指把某個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)的態送到下一個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)之態的映射，不是等距映射的情形。[信](concepts.md#c26)在某個基底下呈對角、看起來像經典的機率分布，本身不構成選出。
definition_en: Selection is the situation in which the map sending the state at one [Moment](concepts.md#c04) to the state at the next [moment](concepts.md#c04) is not an isometry. [Xin](concepts.md#c26) being diagonal in some basis, and so looking like a classical probability distribution, does not by itself constitute selection.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 非坍縮是指在每個[後繼](concepts.md#c06)[時刻](concepts.md#c04)，[形式層](concepts.md#c02)中的[全域態](concepts.md#c25)都未經歷[選出](concepts.md#c32)。非坍縮不否認[信](concepts.md#c26)可以在[記錄基底](concepts.md#c18)下呈對角、看起來像經典的機率分布；它否認的是[選出](concepts.md#c32)。
definition_en: Non-collapse is the condition that at every [Successor](concepts.md#c06) [moment](concepts.md#c04) the [Global State](concepts.md#c25) in the [Formal Layer](concepts.md#c02) undergoes no [Selection](concepts.md#c32). Non-collapse does not deny that [Xin](concepts.md#c26) may be diagonal in the [Record Basis](concepts.md#c18) and look like a classical probability distribution; what it denies is [selection](concepts.md#c32).

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 非退化模型是一個具體的例子，含兩個[刺激](concepts.md#c07)，即[刺激甲](concepts.md#c35)與[刺激乙](concepts.md#c36)；[記錄空間](concepts.md#c15)與[環境空間](concepts.md#c16)皆為二維，基底標為零與一；[刺激空間](concepts.md#c20)為三維，基底為[真空態](concepts.md#c24)、甲、乙；三個空間所列的基底皆為正交歸一基底。[初始信](concepts.md#c09)為[記錄](concepts.md#c17)零。[刺激乙](concepts.md#c36)在[第二時刻](concepts.md#c37)[出現](concepts.md#c08)，[刺激甲](concepts.md#c35)在[第三時刻](concepts.md#c38)[出現](concepts.md#c08)，前三個[時刻](concepts.md#c04)內其餘的[出現](concepts.md#c08)皆為假。[寫入映射](concepts.md#c22)把[真空態](concepts.md#c24)送到[記錄](concepts.md#c17)零與[環境](concepts.md#c11)一，把甲送到「[記錄](concepts.md#c17)零、[環境](concepts.md#c11)零」與「[記錄](concepts.md#c17)一、[環境](concepts.md#c11)一」的等權疊加，把乙送到[記錄](concepts.md#c17)一與[環境](concepts.md#c11)零。
definition_en: The non-degenerate model is a concrete example with two [Stimuli](concepts.md#c07), namely [Stimulus A](concepts.md#c35) and [Stimulus B](concepts.md#c36). The [Record Space](concepts.md#c15) and the [Environment Space](concepts.md#c16) are both two-dimensional, with basis vectors labelled zero and one; the [Stimulus Space](concepts.md#c20) is three-dimensional, with basis the [Vacuum State](concepts.md#c24), A, and B; the bases listed for the three spaces are all orthonormal bases. The [Initial Xin](concepts.md#c09) is [record](concepts.md#c17) zero. [Stimulus B](concepts.md#c36) [occurs](concepts.md#c08) at the [Second Moment](concepts.md#c37) and [Stimulus A](concepts.md#c35) at the [Third Moment](concepts.md#c38); all other [occurrences](concepts.md#c08) within the first three [moments](concepts.md#c04) are false. The [Writing Map](concepts.md#c22) sends the [vacuum state](concepts.md#c24) to [record](concepts.md#c17) zero with [environment](concepts.md#c11) one, sends A to the equal-weight superposition of "[record](concepts.md#c17) zero, [environment](concepts.md#c11) zero" and "[record](concepts.md#c17) one, [environment](concepts.md#c11) one", and sends B to [record](concepts.md#c17) one with [environment](concepts.md#c11) zero.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 刺激甲是[非退化模型](concepts.md#c34)中的兩個[刺激](concepts.md#c07)之一，在[第三時刻](concepts.md#c38)[出現](concepts.md#c08)；僅含刺激甲的[刺激束](concepts.md#c27)，其[編碼](concepts.md#c19)是[刺激空間](concepts.md#c20)中標為甲的基底向量。
definition_en: Stimulus A is one of the two [Stimuli](concepts.md#c07) of the [Non-Degenerate Model](concepts.md#c34); it [occurs](concepts.md#c08) at the [Third Moment](concepts.md#c38), and the [Encoding](concepts.md#c19) of the [stimulus bundle](concepts.md#c27) containing only Stimulus A is the basis vector of the [stimulus space](concepts.md#c20) labelled A.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 刺激乙是[非退化模型](concepts.md#c34)中的兩個[刺激](concepts.md#c07)之一，在[第二時刻](concepts.md#c37)[出現](concepts.md#c08)；僅含刺激乙的[刺激束](concepts.md#c27)，其[編碼](concepts.md#c19)是[刺激空間](concepts.md#c20)中標為乙的基底向量。
definition_en: Stimulus B is one of the two [Stimuli](concepts.md#c07) of the [Non-Degenerate Model](concepts.md#c34); it [occurs](concepts.md#c08) at the [Second Moment](concepts.md#c37), and the [Encoding](concepts.md#c19) of the [stimulus bundle](concepts.md#c27) containing only Stimulus B is the basis vector of the [stimulus space](concepts.md#c20) labelled B.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 第二時刻是[初始時刻](concepts.md#c05)的[後繼](concepts.md#c06)，即編號為二的[時刻](concepts.md#c04)。
definition_en: The second moment is the [Successor](concepts.md#c06) of the [Initial Moment](concepts.md#c05), that is, the [Moment](concepts.md#c04) numbered two.

paper_title: 暗宇宙的本體論
definition: 第三時刻是[第二時刻](concepts.md#c37)的[後繼](concepts.md#c06)，即編號為三的[時刻](concepts.md#c04)。
definition_en: The third moment is the [Successor](concepts.md#c06) of the [Second Moment](concepts.md#c37), that is, the [Moment](concepts.md#c04) numbered three.

paper_title: 生物人個體輸出傾向動力學
definition: 關於一個[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)的三個問題；這裡的[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)是生物人，屬上游所稱的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)：能自述，也能對自己作[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)。對這樣的[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)，個體層的問題只有這三個：它要什麼，對應[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)與[輸出傾向](concepts.md#c02)，研究者單憑[記錄](concepts.md#c06)讀不出[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)的值，只能統計[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)的[記錄](concepts.md#c06)；它能不能做到，對應[門檻](concepts.md#c03)；做完會變成什麼樣，對應[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)外界之後外界的回應、時窗終點的[記錄](concepts.md#c06)，依[判準退場](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09)所記的存續，以及依另訂的事件判準所記的生殖（生殖不屬上游「[解](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c05)」的維度）。三問各自問不同的事：要什麼推不出能不能做到，能做到推不出會做，做了推不出結果是所要的。
definition_en: Three questions about an [individual](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20); the [individual](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20) here is a biological human, a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) in the upstream sense: one who can report on itself and can make a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of itself. For such an [individual](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20), the only questions at the individual level are these three: what it wants, which corresponds to [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) and [output tendency](concepts.md#c02) (the researcher cannot read off the value of the [weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) from the [records](concepts.md#c06) alone and can only work statistically with [records](concepts.md#c06) of [outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)); whether it can do it, which corresponds to the [threshold](concepts.md#c03); and what it becomes after doing it, which corresponds to the environment's response after an [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10), the [record](concepts.md#c06) at the end of the time window, and survival as recorded under a [criterion exit](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09) standard, and reproduction as recorded under a separately specified event criterion (reproduction is not a dimension of the upstream [solution](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c05)). The three questions ask about different things: what is wanted does not imply whether it can be done, being able does not imply doing it, and having done it does not imply that the result is what was wanted.

paper_title: 生物人個體輸出傾向動力學
definition: 研究者對[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)的[記錄](concepts.md#c06)中反覆可見的形狀所作的歸納，描述一個[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)在指定[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下傾向做出哪一類[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)。它是在指定的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)、時窗、分類規則與[門檻](concepts.md#c03)條件下作的歸納。分類規則是研究者的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，所歸的類別不是行為本身自帶的界線。輸出傾向是[記錄](concepts.md#c06)的形狀，與[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)的關係只能是估計，不是[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)的讀數。
definition_en: A generalization by the researcher of the recurring shape in the [records](concepts.md#c06) of [outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28), describing which kind of [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) an [individual](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20) tends to produce under a stated [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23). It is made under a stated [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), time window, classification rule, and [threshold](concepts.md#c03) conditions. The classification rule is the researcher's [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18), and the resulting categories are not boundaries that the behavior carries by itself. An [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) tendency is a shape of the [records](concepts.md#c06); its relation to [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) can only be an estimate and is not a reading of the [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06).

paper_title: 生物人個體輸出傾向動力學
definition: 一條[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)[路徑](concepts.md#c07)成立所需的一組[前件](concepts.md#c08)。[路徑](concepts.md#c07)是研究者在指定[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下劃出的一類[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)序列；[前件](concepts.md#c08)是[路徑](concepts.md#c07)成立所需的各項條件，可以是身體素質、[知識](concepts.md#c13)、時間、位置、外界條件、工具與[資源](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c03)，記在哪一類由研究者講明（見[狀態變數](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c02)、[資源變數](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c03)）。任一[前件](concepts.md#c08)不具備，該[路徑](concepts.md#c07)在該輪不可行；全部具備只表示可行，不表示會發生。
definition_en: The set of [antecedents](concepts.md#c08) required for an [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) [path](concepts.md#c07) to hold. A [path](concepts.md#c07) is a class of [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) sequences drawn by the researcher under a stated [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23); an [antecedent](concepts.md#c08) is any condition the [path](concepts.md#c07) requires, such as bodily qualities, [knowledge](concepts.md#c13), time, position, environmental conditions, tools and [resources](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c03), recorded as a [state variable](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c02) or a [resource variable](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c03), as the researcher states. If any [antecedent](concepts.md#c08) is absent, the [path](concepts.md#c07) is infeasible in that round; if all are present, it is only feasible, not thereby occurring.

paper_title: 生物人個體輸出傾向動力學
definition: 研究者依明示的結果變數、時窗與容許區間，把不同[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)各自不同的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)歷程所得的結果，歸入同一類。這是研究者的外部歸類；它不是[趨同](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c37)（[趨同](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c37)指[耦合](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c36)之下，指定維度上參與者[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)模式之間的距離縮短）。結果同類不推出[路徑](concepts.md#c07)相同，也不推出內部問題或驅動力相同；它也不提供發生頻率。
definition_en: A grouping by the researcher, under a stated outcome variable, time window and tolerance interval, of the outcomes that different [individuals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20) reached through different [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) histories into the same class. It is an external classification by the researcher; it is not [convergence](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c37) ([convergence](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c37) is a shortening of the distance between participants' [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) patterns on a stated dimension under [coupling](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c36)). Sameness of outcome class does not imply sameness of [path](concepts.md#c07), nor sameness of any internal problem or driving force; nor does it supply any frequency of occurrence.

paper_title: 生物人個體輸出傾向動力學
definition: 研究者在自己指定的估值下，對同一輪中已走[路徑](concepts.md#c07)的終點與被排除[路徑](concepts.md#c07)的預期終點所作的比較。被排除[路徑](concepts.md#c07)限於與已走[路徑](concepts.md#c07)互相排斥、且[門檻](concepts.md#c03)具備者；它們沒有發生，其終點只能是依某個依據作的估計，沒有依據時終點未知。機會成本是研究者的比較計算，不是[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)的量，也不屬於[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。
definition_en: A comparison by the researcher, under a valuation the researcher specifies, between the end point of the [path](concepts.md#c07) taken in a round and the expected end points of the excluded [paths](concepts.md#c07). The excluded [paths](concepts.md#c07) are limited to those that are mutually exclusive with the [path](concepts.md#c07) taken and whose [thresholds](concepts.md#c03) are met; they did not occur, so their end points can only be estimates made on some basis, and are unknown where there is none. Opportunity cost is a comparison computed by the researcher; it is not a quantity of the [individual](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20) and does not belong to the [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06).

paper_title: 生物人個體輸出傾向動力學
definition: 研究者在講明的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下，依自己的需要選取、對已發生之事所作的登記；記什麼由研究者的登記動作決定，不預先列舉內容。常見的有時窗內實際發生的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)、起點與終點的[狀態變數](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c02)、[資源變數](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c03)，以及[判準退場](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09)是否發生；所記的內容可以包括發生了什麼、何時、何地、幾次、間隔多久。只登記已發生的事；沒登記的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)仍在[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)裡，可能繼續影響[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。自述登記為一筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)，與其他[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)同地位。[路徑](concepts.md#c07)的[門檻](concepts.md#c03)是研究者的判斷，可標「未知」，與[記錄](concepts.md#c06)並列附上，不算[記錄](concepts.md#c06)。
definition_en: A registration, made by the researcher under a stated [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23) and selected according to the researcher's own need, of what has happened; what is registered is fixed by the researcher's act of registering and is not listed in advance. Commonly it includes the [outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) that actually occurred in the time window, the start-point and end-point [state](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c02) variables and [resource](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c03) variables, and whether [criterion exit](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09) occurred; what is registered may include what happened, when, where, how many times, and at what intervals. Only events that have occurred are registered; unregistered [outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) remain in the [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) and may continue to affect the [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06). A self-report is registered as one [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28), with the same standing as any other [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28). The [threshold](concepts.md#c03) of a [path](concepts.md#c07) is the researcher's judgment, may be marked unknown, and is attached alongside the [records](concepts.md#c06) but is not itself a record.

definition: 研究者在指定[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下劃出的一類[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)序列。怎麼劃是研究者的判定；路徑不是[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)自己帶著的邊界。一條路徑在某一輪是否可行，看它的[門檻](concepts.md#c03)。
definition_en: A class of [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) sequences drawn by the researcher under a stated [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23). How it is drawn is the researcher's determination; a path is not a boundary that the [individual](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20) carries. Whether a path is feasible in a given round is read from its [threshold](concepts.md#c03).
