definition: 一條[路徑](concepts.md#c07)成立所需的各項條件之一，是[門檻](concepts.md#c03)的組成項。可以是身體素質、[知識](concepts.md#c13)、時間、位置、外界條件、工具與[資源](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c03)；記在[狀態變數](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c02)還是[資源變數](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c03)，由研究者講明，不先分類。
definition_en: One of the conditions a [path](concepts.md#c07) requires in order to hold, and a component of the [threshold](concepts.md#c03). It may be bodily qualities, [knowledge](concepts.md#c13), time, position, environmental conditions, tools or [resources](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c03); whether it is recorded as a [state](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c02) variable or a [resource](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c03) variable is stated by the researcher and is not classified in advance.

paper_title: 生物人個體輸出傾向動力學
definition: 指定[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)在所屬[推演輪](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c07)的下一刻[狀態](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c02)、[資源](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c03)，以及[判準退場](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09)的相關[記錄](concepts.md#c06)；若該[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)已被列為指定[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)的[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)、這些欄位已記入該輪的[解](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c05)，則是上游[解](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c05)的單[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)部分。
definition_en: For a specified [individual](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20), the next-moment [state](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c02) and [resources](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c03) in the [derivation round](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c07) it belongs to, together with the relevant [records](concepts.md#c06) of the [criterion exit](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09); if the [individual](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20) is listed as a [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) of the stated [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23) and these fields are entered in that round's [solution](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c05), it is the single-[node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) part of the upstream [solution](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c05).

paper_title: 生物人個體輸出傾向動力學
definition: 一份合成資料表，列出甲、乙、丙、己四人各自在第一輪的處境、[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)對外界的改變，以及第二輪起[門檻](concepts.md#c03)是否具備的變化。人物與數值皆為合成設定，非實測；它是校準用的示例，不作推導來源，也不構成經驗支持。
definition_en: A synthetic data table that lists, for four persons (A, B, C and F), each person's situation in the first round, the changes that the [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) makes to the outside world, and the change from the second round on in whether the [threshold](concepts.md#c03) is met. The persons and figures are synthetic settings, not measurements; the table is an example for calibration, not a source of derivation and not empirical support.

paper_title: 生物人個體輸出傾向動力學
definition: 某一輪中，[門檻](concepts.md#c03)的各項[前件](concepts.md#c08)都具備的[路徑](concepts.md#c07)所成的集合。它回答的是物理上能不能，不回答會不會發生；[前件](concepts.md#c08)隨[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)可能變動，所以每一輪的可行集合可能擴大、縮小或不變。
definition_en: In a given round, the set of [paths](concepts.md#c07) whose [thresholds](concepts.md#c03) have all of their [antecedents](concepts.md#c08) met. It answers whether something is physically possible, not whether it will occur; because [antecedents](concepts.md#c08) may change with [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13), the feasible set of each round may grow, shrink or stay the same.

paper_title: 生物人個體輸出傾向動力學
definition: 一份合成資料表，列出受雇工作、擺攤販售、自行種植販售、出售既有物品、搶劫五條[路徑](concepts.md#c07)各自的[門檻](concepts.md#c03)（[前件](concepts.md#c08)清單）與證據地位。[路徑](concepts.md#c07)與[前件](concepts.md#c08)皆為合成設定，非實測；它是校準用的示例，不作推導來源，也不構成經驗支持。
definition_en: A synthetic data table that lists, for five [paths](concepts.md#c07) (employment, setting up a stall, growing and selling, selling existing goods, and robbery), each path's [threshold](concepts.md#c03) (the list of [antecedents](concepts.md#c08)) and the standing of the evidence. The [paths](concepts.md#c07) and [antecedents](concepts.md#c08) are synthetic settings, not measurements; the table is an example for calibration, not a source of derivation and not empirical support.

paper_title: 生物人個體輸出傾向動力學
definition: 某條[路徑](concepts.md#c07)的[門檻](concepts.md#c03)中，無法直接檢查的[前件](concepts.md#c08)，隨[路徑](concepts.md#c07)而定（有廚師的知識，不推出有醫學的知識）。只能由該[路徑](concepts.md#c07)上的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)推測，記為「由[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)推測」或「未知」，不預設具備。身體與外部條件有可直接[記錄](concepts.md#c06)的物理改變，可直接檢查，不在此列。
definition_en: Among the [antecedents](concepts.md#c08) in the [threshold](concepts.md#c03) of a [path](concepts.md#c07), those that cannot be checked directly; it varies with the [path](concepts.md#c07) (having a cook's knowledge does not imply having medical knowledge). It can only be inferred from the [outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) on that [path](concepts.md#c07), is recorded as "inferred from [outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)" or "unknown", and is not assumed to be met. Bodily and external conditions involve physical changes that can be directly [recorded](concepts.md#c06) and checked directly, and are not included.

paper_title: 生物人個體輸出傾向動力學
definition: 研究者以「存續」（尚未發生[判準退場](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09)）為條件選樣的做法：樣本裡只有尚未[判準退場](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09)的[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)。[判準退場](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09)只取決於研究者所訂判準與實際事件，與[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)的好壞無必然關係，所以存續者的表現不足以直接用來評價好壞；已[判準退場](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09)者留下的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)，凡已[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)別人或留在[信號容器](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26)中者，仍在[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)裡，沒[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)任何人者研究者可能拿不到，所以推不出消失者不可研究。這是研究者的樣本邊界，不是外界有選擇目的。
definition_en: The researcher's practice of selecting a sample conditioned on survival (not yet having undergone [criterion exit](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09)): the sample contains only [individuals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20) that have not yet undergone [criterion exit](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09). Whether [criterion exit](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09) occurs depends only on the criterion the researcher sets and on actual events, and has no necessary relation to whether the [outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) are good or bad, so the performance of survivors is not enough to be used directly for evaluation; the [outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) left by those who have undergone [criterion exit](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09), wherever they have already [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at others or remain in a [signal container](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26), are still in the [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13), while those that [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at no one may be unobtainable by the researcher; so it does not follow that those who have disappeared cannot be studied. This is the researcher's sample boundary, not a purpose of selection on the part of the outside world.

definition: 某個[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)的生殖事件所產生的、新[進場](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c44)的[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)。

definition: [生產](concepts.md#c01)是研究者對[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)所作的一種[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)：在講明的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下，把某段[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)看作[生產](concepts.md#c01)。[生產](concepts.md#c01)不賦予[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)獨立本體。
definition_en: [Production](concepts.md#c01) is a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) a researcher draws over the [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13): under a stated way of [cutting](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), a stretch of [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) is viewed as [production](concepts.md#c01). It gives [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) no independent ontology.

definition_en: A recordable variable that a researcher, under a stated way of [cutting](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), assigns to a [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) to describe how it is at the next moment and in which the [exit criterion](concepts.md#c04) is expressed. What counts as state depends on the [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) boundary; it is a classification under a [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), not a property of the thing itself. Non-transferability and non-storability from the [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)'s viewpoint are common cues, not the definition.

paper_title: 生產動力學
definition: 研究者在講明的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下，為[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)指定的一種可記錄變數，其值在每個[推演輪](concepts.md#c07)中可增可減，由實際事件決定。什麼算資源，隨[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)邊界而定，是[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下的歸類，不是事物本身的性質；常以「在該[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)的視角下可轉移、可儲存」作為辨認依據，但這只是依據，不是定義。記錄[資源變數](concepts.md#c03)的增減，不預設不同[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)的增減對應同一份東西。
definition_en: A recordable variable that a researcher, under a stated way of [cutting](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), assigns to a [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25), whose value may increase or decrease in each [derivation round](concepts.md#c07) according to actual events. What counts as a resource depends on the [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) boundary; it is a classification under a [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), not a property of the thing itself. Transferability and storability from the [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)'s viewpoint are common cues, not the definition. Recording increases and decreases of a [resource variable](concepts.md#c03) presupposes no correspondence between different [nodes](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)' changes.

paper_title: 生產動力學
definition: 研究者在講明的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下，用[狀態變數](concepts.md#c02)表述的一條準則，用來判定[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)在某個[推演輪](concepts.md#c07)中是否[判準退場](concepts.md#c09)。判準是研究者的一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，是定義；是否[判準退場](concepts.md#c09)是該[推演輪](concepts.md#c07)實際的狀態事件，是事實，兩者不互相替代。判準可以是上游所稱的「不再是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)」，也可以是研究者明示的其他定義。[判準退場](concepts.md#c09)是《生產動力學》自己的概念，指依研究者所訂判準記為退出；它與上游的[退場](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43)（不再是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)）不同，兩者可以一致，也可以不一致。
definition_en: A criterion, expressed in [state variables](concepts.md#c02) under a stated way of [cutting](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), by which a researcher decides whether a [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) undergoes [criterion exit](concepts.md#c09) in a given [derivation round](concepts.md#c07). The criterion is a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) by the researcher and hence a definition; whether the [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) actually undergoes [criterion exit](concepts.md#c09) is a fact about the state events of that [derivation round](concepts.md#c07). The two do not substitute for each other. The criterion may be the upstream 'no longer a [vortex](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)' or any other explicitly stated definition. [Criterion exit](concepts.md#c09) is the own concept of 'Production Dynamics': being recorded as leaving under the researcher's stated criterion. It differs from the upstream [exit](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43) (no longer a [vortex](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)); the two may coincide or not.

definition: 研究者在講明的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下，記錄的各[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)下一刻的[狀態變數](concepts.md#c02)、[資源變數](concepts.md#c03)，以及依[退場判準](concepts.md#c04)所記的是否[判準退場](concepts.md#c09)，合起來是該[推演輪](concepts.md#c07)的[解](concepts.md#c05)。[判準退場](concepts.md#c09)只是[解](concepts.md#c05)的一個維度，與其他維度並列；沒有記錄的東西不在[解](concepts.md#c05)裡，但仍在[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)中。
definition_en: The recorded next-moment [state variables](concepts.md#c02) and [resource variables](concepts.md#c03) of the [nodes](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) under a stated way of [cutting](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), together with whether each [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) undergoes [criterion exit](concepts.md#c09) according to the [exit criterion](concepts.md#c04), taken together form the [solution](concepts.md#c05) of that [derivation round](concepts.md#c07). [Criterion exit](concepts.md#c09) is only one dimension of the [solution](concepts.md#c05), alongside the others; what is not recorded is not in the [solution](concepts.md#c05) but remains in [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13).

definition: [推演輪](concepts.md#c07)是研究者在講明的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下，把一個模型往前推進一次的單位：在場的各[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)各自走一次上游的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)、[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)、入[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)的循環，再加上研究者所作的記錄，以及成員依[判準退場](concepts.md#c09)與[進場](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c44)所作的成員變動。單位是整個切出的範圍，不是單一[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)。記錄的內容與成員變動的規則由使用者指定，不假定各[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)同步，[推演輪](concepts.md#c07)只是排序。
definition_en: A [derivation round](concepts.md#c07) is the unit by which a researcher, under a stated way of [cutting](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), advances a model by one step: each [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) present runs once through the upstream loop of [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28), [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) and entry into [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13), after which the researcher makes records and the membership changes through [criterion exit](concepts.md#c09) and [entry](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c44). The unit is the whole cut-out range, not a single [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25). What is recorded and how membership changes are specified by the user; [nodes](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) are not assumed synchronous, and the [round](concepts.md#c07) is only an ordering.

paper_title: 生產動力學
definition: 在講明的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下，依研究者所訂的[退場判準](concepts.md#c04)，某[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)在某個[推演輪](concepts.md#c07)被記為退出。[判準退場](concepts.md#c09)是《生產動力學》自己的概念，不等於上游的[退場](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43)（不再是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)）：判準可以取上游的「不再是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)」，也可以取退休、離職、公司解散或生理界線等其他明示定義，所以兩者可以一致，也可以不一致。是否[判準退場](concepts.md#c09)是該[推演輪](concepts.md#c07)實際的狀態事件，是事實；判準本身是定義。
definition_en: [Criterion exit](concepts.md#c09) is the recording of a [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) as leaving in a given [derivation round](concepts.md#c07) according to the [exit criterion](concepts.md#c04) the researcher has stated under a stated way of [cutting](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23). It is the own concept of 'Production Dynamics' and is not the upstream [exit](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43) (no longer a [vortex](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)): the criterion may be 'no longer a [vortex](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)' or any other explicit definition such as retirement, resignation, dissolution or a physiological threshold, so the two may coincide or not. Whether [criterion exit](concepts.md#c09) occurs is a fact about the state events of that [derivation round](concepts.md#c07); the criterion itself is a definition.

paper_title: 互動動力學-共同外生背景下的二階網路
definition: 配置假定是對一組具體對象所作的假定：在講明的階段，其中某些對象只具有[一階分別](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c24)，其餘對象有[二階分別](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c01)，也有[看法歸屬](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c02)。配置假定不是定理。從外部確認某個對象某一刻有沒有[二階分別](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c01)，[不被保證](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02)；只有找到機制，證明該對象的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)只能由[鎖死的回合](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c25)落出，或只能由[隨機的回合](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c26)落出，「對象具有二階分別」這一半的假定對它才不成立。
definition_en: A configuration assumption is an assumption made about a set of concrete objects: at a stated stage, some of the objects have only [First-Order Distinction](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c24), and the others have [Second-Order Distinction](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c01) and also [View Attribution](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c02). A configuration assumption is not a theorem. Confirming from outside that an object has [second-order distinction](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c01) at some moment is [Not Guaranteed](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02); the half of the assumption that the object has second-order distinction fails for that object only if a mechanism is found showing that its [Outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) can come only from [locked-in rounds](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c25) or only from [random rounds](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c26).

paper_title: 互動動力學-共同外生背景下的二階網路
definition: 外生背景是在講明的時窗與[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下，視為從模型外部進入、不隨模型中的[迴路](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c31)更新的背景。它是範圍上的設定，不主張背景不變；進入模型的是背景，不是各個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)從中取得的內容；每個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)只拿得到[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它自己的那一部分，各個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)取得的內容可以不同。
definition_en: Exogenous background is a background that, under a stated time window and a stated [Cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), is treated as entering the model from outside and as not being updated by the [Loops](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c31) in the model. It is a scope setting and does not claim that the background is unchanging; what enters the model is the background, not what each [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) draws from it; each [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) gets only the part that [Arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it, and what each [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) obtains may differ.

paper_title: 互動動力學-共同外生背景下的二階網路
definition: 驅動力不可確認是這個結論：對不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)的對象，它的驅動力，也就是動機、需求與目的，從外部不能被完整觀測，不能被對象自己的自述確認，旁人事後對動機的判斷也只是[看法歸屬](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c02)或[印象](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c45)，不能算證實；動機本身不憑自身[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)旁人。適用範圍：一切不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)的對象，不分年齡，也不分有無[二階分別](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c01)；從外部無法確認對象是否被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)，只能假定。
definition_en: The Unconfirmability of Drives is the conclusion that the drive of an object that is not in [Lock-in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), meaning its motive, need, or purpose, cannot be completely observed from outside, cannot be confirmed by the object's own account, and a judgment about the motive made by others afterwards is only a [View Attribution](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c02) or an [Impression](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c45) and does not count as verification; the motive itself does not [Arrive](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at others by itself. Scope: every object that is not in [Lock-in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), of any age, whether or not it has [Second-Order Distinction](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c01); whether an object is in [Lock-in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12) cannot be confirmed from outside and can only be assumed.

paper_title: 互動動力學-共同外生背景下的二階網路
definition: 二階網路是由具有[二階分別](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c01)與[看法歸屬](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c02)的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)，以及它們之間的[耦合](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c36)所構成的集合：一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)對另一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)作[看法歸屬](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c02)，而不只把它當成一筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)來反應；每個參與者在參與的那一刻，既有[二階分別](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c01)，也有[看法歸屬](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c02)，兩者缺一不可。參與者至少兩個，但不必同時在場：寫下內容的一方，在寫下的那一刻是參與者，之後[退場](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43)不影響這一點。網路在[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)中形成的規律，包括規範與制度，是它的模式，不是另一類實體。
definition_en: A second-order network is the set formed by [Selves](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that have [Second-Order Distinction](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c01) and [View Attribution](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c02), together with the [Couplings](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c36) among them: one [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) makes a [view attribution](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c02) on another [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)'s [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28), rather than only reacting to it as an [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28); every participant, at the moment of taking part, has both [second-order distinction](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c01) and [view attribution](../paper_fb0addca_42b6_4884_aa18_438c695747ab/concepts.md#c02), and neither alone suffices. There are at least two participants, who need not be present at the same time: a party who writes content is a participant at the moment of writing, and a later [Exit](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43) does not change that. The regularities that form in the network over [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13), including norms and institutions, are its patterns and not a separate kind of entity.

paper_title: 互動動力學-共同外生背景下的二階網路
definition: 默契是在指定的情境類型與維度中，兩個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)經歷反覆的[專屬歷史](concepts.md#c05)，在可比較的情境下，呈現不必每次重新逐項指導、仍能相容接續的行為模式。判準是[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)與行為模式，不是預言：它不要求任何一方事先算準對方的下一步，不要求友善，不要求彼此透明，也不要求一方對另一方的[印象](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c45)穩定。互動次數多，不等於已有默契。
definition_en: Tacit coordination is the behavioral pattern shown when, in a specified type of situation and along a specified dimension, two [Selves](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) have gone through a repeated [Dedicated History](concepts.md#c05), and in comparable situations can continue compatibly without being instructed item by item each time. The criterion is [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) and behavioral pattern, not prediction: it requires neither that either side calculate the other's next step beforehand, nor friendliness, nor mutual transparency, nor stability of one side's [Impression](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c45) of the other. A large number of interactions does not by itself amount to tacit coordination.

definition: 指定協調是這樣一種判準：對一項已界定的任務，依明列的驗收條件，檢查某段實際發生的行動序列；序列符合驗收條件，稱這段序列在該任務上呈現協調。任務是研究者指定的判準，不是參與者驅動力的代名詞；成功也不等於關係改善或彼此理解。
definition_en: Specified coordination is a criterion: for a defined task, the actual sequence of actions that took place is checked against explicitly stated acceptance conditions; a sequence that meets them is said to show coordination on that task. The task is a criterion specified by the researcher and is not a stand-in for the participants' drives; success does not imply improved relations or mutual understanding.

definition: 失配是在研究者指定的維度與相容判準下，兩個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)相鄰的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)序列不相容。判準看的是序列相容與否，不是任何一方想要而沒得到，也不是期待被違反。
definition_en: A mismatch is, along a researcher-specified dimension and under a specified compatibility criterion, an incompatibility between the adjacent sequences of [Outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) of two [Selves](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19). The criterion concerns whether the sequence is compatible, not whether either party wanted something and did not get it, nor whether an expectation was violated.

definition: 修復是[失配](concepts.md#c08)之後，在同一維度與同一相容判準下，後續[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)序列重新相容。修復只是序列的記錄，不表示歸屬得到了檢驗，也不表示任何一方得到了想要的，也不表示關係改善。
definition_en: A repair is, after a [Mismatch](concepts.md#c08), a renewed compatibility of the subsequent sequence of [Outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) along the same dimension and under the same compatibility criterion. A repair is only a record of the sequence; it does not mean that the attribution was tested, that either party got what it wanted, or that relations improved.

definition: 衝突是在研究者指定的維度與時窗內，兩個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)之間形成的[太極](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c39)：雙方的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)都針對對方在該維度上的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)，方向相反，而且每一方的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)對方，都強化對方自己的方向。至少一方的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)已[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)對方（含經由轉述），才可能形成。各做各的相反方向、沒有針對對方的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)，不是衝突。衝突是對序列的描述，不是對任何一方內在狀態或驅動力的描述。
definition_en: A conflict is, along a researcher-specified dimension and within a specified time window, a [Taiji](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c39) formed between two [Selves](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19): each side's [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) is aimed at the other's [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) along that dimension, in opposite directions, and each side's [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) [arriving](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the other strengthens the other's own direction. It can form only after the [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) of at least one has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the other (including through relay). Opposite directions pursued independently, without aiming at the other's [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28), are not a conflict. A conflict is a description of a sequence, not of any party's inner state or drive.

definition: 不被保證是禁止的一種形式：它不說某件事[不會發生](concepts.md#c01)，而是說框架不斷言它必然發生。具體情形中是否另有約束使它成立，框架也不斷言；要主張它必然發生，必須另外寫明所依賴的約束。它限制的是預測能有多少信心。
definition_en: Not Guaranteed is one form of prohibition: it does not state that something [never occurs](concepts.md#c01), but that the framework does not assert that it necessarily happens. Whether other constraints make it hold in a particular case, the framework does not assert either; to claim that it necessarily happens, one must state the constraints relied on. What it limits is how much confidence a prediction can have.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 宇宙是有[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)的那一個世界。宇宙中不由過去決定的只有兩樣：[宇宙初態](concepts.md#c11)，與每一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)的結果；其他一切，包括每一次[寫入](concepts.md#c09)，都由到當時為止的[歷史](concepts.md#c10)決定。
definition_en: The universe is the one world in which there is [Collapse](concepts.md#c07). Only two things in the universe are not determined by the past: the [Initial State of the Universe](concepts.md#c11) and the outcome of each [collapse](concepts.md#c07); everything else, including every [Writing](concepts.md#c09), is determined by the [History](concepts.md#c10) up to that point.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 呈現是[宇宙](concepts.md#c03)中的任何一部分。
definition_en: A presentation is any part of the [Universe](concepts.md#c03).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 分支是一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)可能得出的每一個結果。
definition_en: A branch is each possible outcome of a [Collapse](concepts.md#c07).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 權重是每個[分支](concepts.md#c05)的輕重。一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)的各[分支](concepts.md#c05)權重都不小於零，總和為一。一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)的權重，是[宇宙](concepts.md#c03)的權重落在它身上的那一部分：把各[分支](concepts.md#c05)看成該[呈現](concepts.md#c04)的結果之後，同一個結果的權重相加。權重是[分支](concepts.md#c05)的輕重，不是任何[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)內部的參數。
definition_en: A weight is how heavy each [Branch](concepts.md#c05) is. The weights of the [branches](concepts.md#c05) of a [Collapse](concepts.md#c07) are all non-negative and sum to one. The weight of a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) is the part of the weight of the [Universe](concepts.md#c03) that falls on it: once each [branch](concepts.md#c05) is read as an outcome for that [presentation](concepts.md#c04), the weights of [branches](concepts.md#c05) giving the same outcome are added together. A weight belongs to [branches](concepts.md#c05); it is not an internal parameter of any [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 坍塌是依[權重](concepts.md#c06)從各[分支](concepts.md#c05)中定出一個的事件。未被定出的[分支](concepts.md#c05)，不留在[宇宙](concepts.md#c03)中。給定到當時為止的[歷史](concepts.md#c10)，坍塌的結果依[權重](concepts.md#c06)定出，[歷史](concepts.md#c10)中沒有任何東西能比[權重](concepts.md#c06)多說一點。
definition_en: A collapse is the event in which one of the [Branches](concepts.md#c05) is settled according to the [Weights](concepts.md#c06). [Branches](concepts.md#c05) not settled do not remain in the [Universe](concepts.md#c03). Given the [History](concepts.md#c10) up to that point, the outcome of a collapse is settled according to the [weights](concepts.md#c06), and nothing in the [history](concepts.md#c10) says anything more than the [weights](concepts.md#c06).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 時刻是一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)。[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)一次一次發生，排成一條全序；沒有[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)，就沒有時刻。一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)的時刻，是[涉及](concepts.md#c14)它的那些[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)；它的下一時刻，是下一次[涉及](concepts.md#c14)它的[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)；兩次之間，對它沒有時刻。
definition_en: A moment is a [Collapse](concepts.md#c07). [Collapses](concepts.md#c07) happen one at a time and form a total order; without [collapse](concepts.md#c07) there is no moment. The moments of a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) are the [collapses](concepts.md#c07) that [involve](concepts.md#c14) it; its next moment is the next [collapse](concepts.md#c07) that [involves](concepts.md#c14) it; between two of them, there is no moment for it.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 寫入是每一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)之前，先加入[歷史](concepts.md#c10)的一筆內容。寫入的內容，完全由到當時為止的[歷史](concepts.md#c10)決定。[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)的每一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，都在[歷史](concepts.md#c10)中留下一次寫入。
definition_en: A writing is the item added to [History](concepts.md#c10) before each [Collapse](concepts.md#c07). The content of a writing is entirely determined by the [history](concepts.md#c10) up to that point. Every [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) leaves a writing in [history](concepts.md#c10).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 歷史始於[宇宙初態](concepts.md#c11)，其後是每一次[寫入](concepts.md#c09)與每一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)的結果，依[時刻](concepts.md#c08)排列。[宇宙](concepts.md#c03)只有一部歷史；歷史只往後追加，已經在其中的，不會離開。
definition_en: History begins with the [Initial State of the Universe](concepts.md#c11), followed by every [Writing](concepts.md#c09) and the outcome of every [Collapse](concepts.md#c07), arranged by [Moment](concepts.md#c08). The [universe](concepts.md#c03) has only one history; history is only ever appended to, and nothing already in it ever leaves.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 宇宙初態是第一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)之前已經在那裡的一切，是[歷史](concepts.md#c10)的起點。內容不分析。
definition_en: The initial state of the universe is everything that is already there before the first [Collapse](concepts.md#c07); it is the starting point of [History](concepts.md#c10). Its content is not analyzed.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 生成函數把到當時為止的[歷史](concepts.md#c10)，包括剛發生的那一次[寫入](concepts.md#c09)，對應到下一[時刻](concepts.md#c08)各[分支](concepts.md#c05)的[權重](concepts.md#c06)。它只取[歷史](concepts.md#c10)，只有一個，內部不分析。
definition_en: The generating function maps the [History](concepts.md#c10) up to that point, including the [Writing](concepts.md#c09) that has just taken place, to the [Weights](concepts.md#c06) of the [Branches](concepts.md#c05) of the next [Moment](concepts.md#c08). It takes nothing but [history](concepts.md#c10), there is only one of it, and its internals are not analyzed.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)收到的[刺激](concepts.md#c53)、[涉及](concepts.md#c14)它而實際結果沒有落在它身上的[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)，以及[宇宙初態](concepts.md#c11)，都成為它[歷史](concepts.md#c10)的一部分，這就是到達。也就是說，一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)所處的物理條件，不論有沒有改變，都成為它的[歷史](concepts.md#c10)；一件可能發生在它身上、結果沒有發生的事，也算在內。
definition_en: The [Stimuli](concepts.md#c53) a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) receives, the [Collapses](concepts.md#c07) that [involve](concepts.md#c14) it but whose actual outcome does not fall on it, and the [Initial State of the Universe](concepts.md#c11) all become part of its [History](concepts.md#c10); this is arrival. In other words, the physical conditions a [presentation](concepts.md#c04) is in, whether or not they change, all become its [history](concepts.md#c10); something that could have happened to it but did not also counts.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 一次[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)的結果以正的[權重](concepts.md#c06)落在一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)身上，這次[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)就涉及它。
definition_en: A [Collapse](concepts.md#c07) involves a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) when its outcome falls on that [presentation](concepts.md#c04) with positive [Weight](concepts.md#c06).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 鎖死是一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)的下一[時刻](concepts.md#c08)只有一個[權重](concepts.md#c06)不為零的[分支](concepts.md#c05)的情形。鎖死是被[涉及](concepts.md#c14)了，卻只有一個結果；一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)沒有[時刻](concepts.md#c08)的期間，不是鎖死。
definition_en: Lock-in is the situation in which the next [Moment](concepts.md#c08) of a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) has only one [Branch](concepts.md#c05) of non-zero [Weight](concepts.md#c06). Lock-in means being [involved](concepts.md#c14) yet having only one outcome; a period in which a [presentation](concepts.md#c04) has no [moment](concepts.md#c08) is not lock-in.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)自己的那一段，是它下一[時刻](concepts.md#c08)的[權重](concepts.md#c06)所依賴的那部分[歷史](concepts.md#c10)：[歷史](concepts.md#c10)中某一件若換成別的，影響沿著[歷史](concepts.md#c10)傳下來，會改變它下一[時刻](concepts.md#c08)[權重](concepts.md#c06)的分布，這一件就屬於它自己的那一段。那一段由依賴決定，不由任何[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)決定；它是同一部[歷史](concepts.md#c10)的一部分，不同[呈現](concepts.md#c04)自己的那一段可以重疊。
definition_en: The own segment of a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) is the part of [History](concepts.md#c10) on which the [Weights](concepts.md#c06) of its next [Moment](concepts.md#c08) depend: an item of [history](concepts.md#c10) belongs to its own segment if replacing that item with something else would, with the influence passing down the [history](concepts.md#c10), change the distribution of its [weights](concepts.md#c06) for the next [moment](concepts.md#c08). The segment is determined by dependence, not by any [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18); it is part of the one [history](concepts.md#c10), and the own segments of different [presentations](concepts.md#c04) may overlap.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 個體是被某個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)出來的[呈現](concepts.md#c04)。同一段[宇宙](concepts.md#c03)，被[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)為一個個體或許多個個體，皆成立。
definition_en: An individual is a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) marked off by some [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) through [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18). The same stretch of the [Universe](concepts.md#c03) may be [distinguished](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) as one individual or as many, and either holds.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 同一是一種[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)：某一[時刻](concepts.md#c08)的[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)與另一[時刻](concepts.md#c08)的[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)是不是同一個，由作出[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)決定。一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)是不是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)，不是[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)；兩個[時刻](concepts.md#c08)的[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)是不是同一個，是[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)。
definition_en: Identity is a kind of [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18): whether a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) at one [Moment](concepts.md#c08) and a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) at another [moment](concepts.md#c08) are the same one is decided by the [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that makes the [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18). Whether a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04) is a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) is not a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18); whether the [wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) at two [moments](concepts.md#c08) are the same one is.

concept: 對他者認識的不可完備性
paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 對他者認識的不可完備性是這個結論：沒有任何[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)能保證自己[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)完了另一個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)。[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)只能用已經[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)來[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)對方；對方的訊息[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它是一件事，它的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)又是另一件，在兩者之間，對方的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)仍可能增長，而對方不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)時，對方下一[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)的結果不能事先推出（[黑箱律](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c25)）。此外，對方[自己的那一段](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17)中只[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)對方的部分，沒有任何東西保證也會[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它；而它的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)作為一次[寫入](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c29)，一旦成為對方[自己的那一段](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17)的一部分，也可能改變對方下一[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。
definition_en: The Incompleteness of Knowing Others is the conclusion that no [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) can guarantee that it has finished [distinguishing](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) another [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16). A self can distinguish the other only through the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it; the other's information [arriving](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) is one event and the self's [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) is another, and between them the other's [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) may still grow, while, when the other is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), the outcome of the other's next [Moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) cannot be derived beforehand ([Law of the Black Box](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c25)). Moreover, nothing guarantees that the parts of the other's [Own Segment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17) that [arrive](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) only at the other also [arrive](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the self; and once the self's [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18), as a [Writing](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c29), becomes part of the other's [own segment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17), it may change the other's [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) for its next [moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 粒度是這個條件結論：若把同一段[宇宙](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c02)描述成較粗與較細的[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)，且較粗[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)的結果投影可由較細[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)的結果投影經某映射取得，則較粗[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)分布等於較細[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)分布經該映射推前所得。粒度只主張這種結果投影相容的描述之間一致，不主張任意兩個結果投影必然相容。
definition_en: Granularity is the conditional conclusion that, when the same stretch of the [Universe](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c02) is described by a coarser and a finer [Presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04), and the outcome projection of the coarser [presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) can be obtained from the outcome projection of the finer [presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) by a mapping, the [Weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) distribution of the coarser [presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) equals the pushforward, by that mapping, of the [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) distribution of the finer [presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04). Granularity asserts consistency only between descriptions whose outcome projections are compatible in this sense; it does not assert that arbitrary outcome projections must be compatible.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 時鐘時間是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)以時鐘量到的時間，依物理，不形式化。它與[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)不同：[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)只是[坍塌](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c08)的次序，任何[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)都量不到。
definition_en: Clock time is the time a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) measures with a clock; it follows physics and is not formalized. It differs from a [Moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09): [moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) are only the order of [Collapses](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c08), which no [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) can measure.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 重切是改變[切法](concepts.md#c23)：把一個部分切成許多部分，或把許多部分合成一個。「結論經得起重切」只適用於結果投影相容的重切：同一段[宇宙](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c02)被描述成較粗與較細的[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)時，較粗[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)的結果投影可由較細[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)的結果投影經某映射取得。[迴路](concepts.md#c31)、[知見障](concepts.md#c35)、[耦合](concepts.md#c36)、[太極](concepts.md#c39)與[更新](concepts.md#c42)所得的結論，在這些結果投影相容的重切下都必須不變；[印象](concepts.md#c45)不受此要求。在這些相容重切之下，[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)與推論不變；[耦合](concepts.md#c36)、[太極](concepts.md#c39)與[印象](concepts.md#c45)在描述[迴路](concepts.md#c31)之間的關係時，若相關部分被合併，這些關係轉為內部結構，不再以關係的形式出現。任意兩個[切法](concepts.md#c23)之間是否滿足這項結果投影相容條件，不由此定義保證。
definition_en: Recutting is changing the [Cut](concepts.md#c23): cutting one part into many, or merging many parts into one. Saying that a conclusion survives recutting applies only to outcome-projection-compatible recuttings: when the same stretch of the [Universe](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c02) is described by a coarser and a finer [Presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04), the outcome projection of the coarser [presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) can be obtained from the outcome projection of the finer [presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) by a mapping. Conclusions derived from [Loop](concepts.md#c31), [Cognitive Obscuration](concepts.md#c35), [Coupling](concepts.md#c36), [Taiji](concepts.md#c39), and [Renewal](concepts.md#c42) must remain unchanged under such outcome-projection-compatible recuttings; [Impression](concepts.md#c45) is exempt from this requirement. Under such compatible recuttings, [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) and inferences do not change; when [Coupling](concepts.md#c36), [Taiji](concepts.md#c39), and [Impression](concepts.md#c45) describe relations between [Loops](concepts.md#c31), merging the relevant parts turns those relations into internal structure, so they no longer appear as relations. This definition does not guarantee that arbitrary pairs of [Cuts](concepts.md#c23) satisfy this outcome-projection compatibility condition.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 切法是分析者的一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)：把哪一段[宇宙](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c02)看作一個[迴路](concepts.md#c31)。敘述[迴路](concepts.md#c31)必須切出部分，所以切法無法避免，必須講明。
definition_en: A cut is a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) made by the analyst: which stretch of the [Universe](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c02) is taken as one [Loop](concepts.md#c31). Describing a [loop](concepts.md#c31) requires cutting out parts, so a cut cannot be avoided and must be stated.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 邊界是一個範例的地理邊界與時間邊界。它是一次[切法](concepts.md#c23)，每個範例都必須先講明。
definition_en: The boundary is the geographical and temporal boundary of a worked example. It is a [Cut](concepts.md#c23), and every example must state it first.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 節點是[切法](concepts.md#c23)下的一個[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)，是假名。節點有三類：[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)、[信號容器](concepts.md#c26)、[隨機源](concepts.md#c27)。
definition_en: A node is a [Presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) under a [Cut](concepts.md#c23); it is a provisional name. There are three kinds of node: the [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), the [Signal Container](concepts.md#c26), and the [Random Source](concepts.md#c27).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 信號容器是這樣的[節點](concepts.md#c25)：它不是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)，從這一[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)起每一步都被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)。它通常持續存在，在許多[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)向[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)[輸出](concepts.md#c28)，但這不是條件。它的內容可以由[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)寫下，例如書、法條；也可以來自其他[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)，例如望遠鏡帶來的觀測。[知見障](concepts.md#c35)對它沒有內容；它也不能成為[印象](concepts.md#c45)的對象。
definition_en: A signal container is a [Node](concepts.md#c25) that is not a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) and, from this [moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) on, is [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12) at every step. It usually persists and [outputs](concepts.md#c28) to [wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) at many [Moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09), but this is not a condition. Its content may be written by [wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), as with books or statutes, or may come from other [Presentations](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04), as with observations brought by a telescope. [Cognitive Obscuration](concepts.md#c35) has no content for it; nor can it be the object of an [Impression](concepts.md#c45).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 隨機源是這樣的[節點](concepts.md#c25)：它不是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)，但這一[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)或之後至少還有一個[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)它不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)。例如擲出的骰子、放射性衰變的原子。它不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)時，只能談[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)；它也不能成為[印象](concepts.md#c45)的對象。
definition_en: A random source is a [Node](concepts.md#c25) that is not a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), but at this [moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) or later there is still at least one [Moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) at which it is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12). Examples are a thrown die and a radioactively decaying atom. When it is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), only its [weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) can be discussed; nor can it be the object of an [Impression](concepts.md#c45).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 輸出是一個[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)的[坍塌](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c08)結果，以及它的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)內容。
definition_en: The output of a [Presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) is the outcomes of its [Collapses](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c08), together with the content of its [Distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 邊是[節點](concepts.md#c25)之間有向的關係：一個[節點](concepts.md#c25)的[輸出](concepts.md#c28)，參與另一個[節點](concepts.md#c25)的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。邊本身不帶大小：一條邊影響多大，取決於接收者的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)，不是邊本身的屬性。
definition_en: An edge is a directed relation between [Nodes](concepts.md#c25): the [Output](concepts.md#c28) of one [node](concepts.md#c25) takes part in the [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) of another. An edge carries no magnitude of its own: how much an edge matters depends on the receiver's [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13), not on the edge.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 時序是[邊](concepts.md#c29)的先後，以及[迴路](concepts.md#c31)繞一圈要多久；[節點](concepts.md#c25)可以在[邊界](concepts.md#c24)內的某個時間出現或消失。
definition_en: Timing is the order in which [Edges](concepts.md#c29) occur and how long a [Loop](concepts.md#c31) takes to go round once; [Nodes](concepts.md#c25) may appear or disappear at some time within the [Boundary](concepts.md#c24).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 迴路是這樣的結構：一個[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)的[輸出](concepts.md#c28)，經由自己或其他[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)，又參與它自己的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。迴路一律指在講明的[切法](concepts.md#c23)下的迴路；跨[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)持續存在是[不被保證](concepts.md#c02)的。
definition_en: A loop is a structure in which the [Output](concepts.md#c28) of a [Presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04), through itself or through other [presentations](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04), takes part again in its own [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06). A loop is always a loop under a stated [Cut](concepts.md#c23); persistence across [Moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) is [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 正回饋是[迴路](concepts.md#c31)的一種作用：[迴路](concepts.md#c31)自己的一次[輸出](concepts.md#c28)繞回來，把[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)推向產生這次[輸出](concepts.md#c28)的那個方向。方向必須包含這次[輸出](concepts.md#c28)，由它錨定；方向劃得多粗，屬於[切法](concepts.md#c23)。
definition_en: Positive feedback is an action of a [Loop](concepts.md#c31): one of the loop's own [Outputs](concepts.md#c28) comes back round and pushes the [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) toward the direction that produced that [output](concepts.md#c28). The direction must contain that [output](concepts.md#c28), which anchors it; how coarsely the direction is drawn belongs to the [Cut](concepts.md#c23).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 負回饋是[迴路](concepts.md#c31)的一種作用：[迴路](concepts.md#c31)自己的一次[輸出](concepts.md#c28)繞回來，把[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)推離產生這次[輸出](concepts.md#c28)的那個方向。方向必須包含這次[輸出](concepts.md#c28)，由它錨定；方向劃得多粗，屬於[切法](concepts.md#c23)。抵抗若來自另一個[迴路](concepts.md#c31)的[輸出](concepts.md#c28)經由[耦合](concepts.md#c36)壓過來，不是負回饋。
definition_en: Negative feedback is an action of a [Loop](concepts.md#c31): one of the loop's own [Outputs](concepts.md#c28) comes back round and pushes the [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) away from the direction that produced that [output](concepts.md#c28). The direction must contain that [output](concepts.md#c28), which anchors it; how coarsely the direction is drawn belongs to the [Cut](concepts.md#c23). Resistance that comes from the [output](concepts.md#c28) of another [loop](concepts.md#c31) pressing in through [Coupling](concepts.md#c36) is not negative feedback.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 速度是[迴路](concepts.md#c31)繞一圈要多久，以[時鐘時間](concepts.md#c21)計，與[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)不同。
definition_en: Loop speed is how long a [Loop](concepts.md#c31) takes to go round once, measured in [Clock Time](concepts.md#c21), which differs from [Moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 知見障是這件事：一個[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)在下一[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)各個結果的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)，總和為一，所以推高一個方向，必然壓低其餘方向的總和。一切學習都有代價，知與障是同一件事。知見障只保證此消彼長，不決定一筆[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)推高哪個方向、推高多少。
definition_en: Cognitive obscuration is the fact that the [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) of the outcomes of a [Presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) at its next [Moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) sum to one, so that pushing one direction up necessarily pushes the total of the other directions down. All learning has a cost; knowing and obscuration are one and the same. Cognitive obscuration guarantees only that one rises as the others fall; it does not decide which direction an [Arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) pushes up, or by how much.

statements.section: 範例：金黃色葡萄球菌的抗藥性

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 耦合是這樣的情形：兩個或多個[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)的[自己的那一段](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17)，在一個講明的[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)上重疊。參與耦合的可以是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)，也可以是由許多[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)構成的[迴路](concepts.md#c31)。重疊有兩種方式：同一件事[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它們，例如同一個[輸出](concepts.md#c28)，或[宇宙初態](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c14)；或者它們的[輸出](concepts.md#c28)互相[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)。耦合總是相對於一個講明的[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)而言。
definition_en: Coupling is the situation in which the [Own Segments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17) of two or more [Presentations](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) overlap in a stated [Arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10). What takes part in coupling may be [Wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), or [Loops](concepts.md#c31) made of many [presentations](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04). The overlap takes one of two forms: the same thing [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at all of them, such as the same [Output](concepts.md#c28) or the [Initial State of the Universe](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c14), or their [outputs](concepts.md#c28) [arrive](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at one another. Coupling is always relative to a stated [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 趨同是[耦合](concepts.md#c36)之下的一種走向：在一個講明的維度上，參與者[輸出](concepts.md#c28)的模式之間的距離縮短。
definition_en: Convergence is one direction of development under [Coupling](concepts.md#c36): along a stated dimension, the distance between the patterns of the participants' [Outputs](concepts.md#c28) shrinks.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 趨異是[耦合](concepts.md#c36)之下的一種走向：在一個講明的維度上，參與者[輸出](concepts.md#c28)的模式之間的距離拉長。
definition_en: Divergence is one direction of development under [Coupling](concepts.md#c36): along a stated dimension, the distance between the patterns of the participants' [Outputs](concepts.md#c28) grows.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 太極是這樣的結構：兩個方向相反的[正回饋](concepts.md#c32)[迴路](concepts.md#c31)互相[耦合](concepts.md#c36)，在[耦合](concepts.md#c36)中[趨異](concepts.md#c38)，形成動態平衡。每一方的[輸出](concepts.md#c28)[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)另一方，都強化了另一方自己的方向，所以任何一方壯大，都在餵養對方。太極發生在[迴路](concepts.md#c31)與[迴路](concepts.md#c31)之間，不要求每個參與者都是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)；「方向相反」必須講明是在哪一個維度上判斷。
definition_en: Taiji is a structure in which two [Loops](concepts.md#c31) of [Positive Feedback](concepts.md#c32) pointing in opposite directions are [coupled](concepts.md#c36) with each other and show [Divergence](concepts.md#c38) within that [coupling](concepts.md#c36), forming a dynamic balance. Each side's [Output](concepts.md#c28), [arriving](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the other, strengthens the other's own direction, so whichever side grows is feeding its opponent. Taiji takes place between [loops](concepts.md#c31), and does not require every participant to be a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16); for "opposite directions", the dimension on which this is judged must be stated.

definition: 一方退出是[太極](concepts.md#c39)結束的一種方式：其中一方的[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)大多[退場](concepts.md#c43)，或者它不再自我強化。
definition_en: Withdrawal of one side is one way a [Taiji](concepts.md#c39) ends: most of the [Wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) on one side [exit](concepts.md#c43), or that side no longer reinforces itself.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 合流是[太極](concepts.md#c39)結束的一種方式：[耦合](concepts.md#c36)的走向由[趨異](concepts.md#c38)轉為[趨同](concepts.md#c37)，兩個[迴路](concepts.md#c31)合成一個。在[重切](concepts.md#c22)之下，這也可以看作兩個[迴路](concepts.md#c31)被切成了一個。
definition_en: Merging is one way a [Taiji](concepts.md#c39) ends: the [Coupling](concepts.md#c36) turns from [Divergence](concepts.md#c38) to [Convergence](concepts.md#c37), and the two [Loops](concepts.md#c31) become one. Under [Recutting](concepts.md#c22), this can also be seen as the two [loops](concepts.md#c31) being cut as one.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 更新是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)的進出：有些[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)[退場](concepts.md#c43)，有些[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)[進場](concepts.md#c44)。
definition_en: Renewal is the going and coming of [Wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16): some [wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) [exit](concepts.md#c43) and some [Presentations](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) [enter](concepts.md#c44).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 退場是一個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)不再是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)：它在某一[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)，在它的下一[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)不是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)。
definition_en: Exit is a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) ceasing to be a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16): it is a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) at one [Moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) and is not a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) at its next [moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 進場是一個[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)開始成為[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)：它在某一[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)不是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)，在它的下一[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)；或者在它的第一個[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)就是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)。
definition_en: Entry is a [Presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) beginning to be a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16): it is not a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) at one [Moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) and is a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) at its next [moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09), or it is already a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) at its first [moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09).

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 印象是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)對一個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，也就是它對那個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)的估計。對象可以是另一個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)，也可以是這個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)自己，此時是[自我印象](concepts.md#c46)。對[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)的一切統計估計，包括史料的統計，都屬於印象。印象的材料有三個來源：對方過去的[輸出](concepts.md#c28)；[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)自己和對方重疊的[那一段](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17)；對方所在的[耦合](concepts.md#c36)，例如角色、制度、信仰。
definition_en: An impression is a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) made by a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) of a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), that is, its estimate of that [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)'s [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06). The object may be another [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) or the [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) itself, in which case it is a [Self-Impression](concepts.md#c46). Every statistical estimate about a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), including statistics of historical records, is an impression. The material of an impression has three sources: the other's past [Outputs](concepts.md#c28); the part of the self's [own segment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17) that overlaps with the other's; and the [Couplings](concepts.md#c36) the other is in, such as roles, institutions and beliefs.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 自我印象是對象為自己的[印象](concepts.md#c45)：一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)對自己的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)。
definition_en: A self-impression is an [Impression](concepts.md#c45) whose object is oneself: a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)'s [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of itself.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 份量是一筆[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)能移動多少[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)，是[生成函數](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c15)內部的事。份量不能相加：一筆[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)的效果，取決於它之前的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)。
definition_en: The impact of an [Arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) is how much [Weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) it can move; it is a matter internal to the [Generating Function](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c15). Impacts do not add up: the effect of an [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) depends on the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) before it.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 頻率是[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)多常發生。它是應用時必須寫明的[份量](concepts.md#c47)假定之一。
definition_en: Frequency is how often an [Arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) happens. It is one of the assumptions about [Impact](concepts.md#c47) that an application must state.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 歧異度是一筆[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)和接收者過去收到的東西差多遠。它是相對於接收者的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)而言的：同一個[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)，落在不同的[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)上，歧異度可以完全不同。它是應用時必須寫明的[份量](concepts.md#c47)假定之一。
definition_en: Discrepancy is how far an [Arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) lies from what the receiver has received before. It is relative to the receiver's [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13): the same [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10), falling on different [Wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), can have entirely different discrepancy. It is one of the assumptions about [Impact](concepts.md#c47) that an application must state.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 應用假定是這個假定：在生物學與社會科學的層次上，一個[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)的下一[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)若不能由那個層次可得的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)唯一推出，就假定它不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)。它不是定理。
definition_en: The application assumption is the assumption that, at the levels of biology and the social sciences, if the next [moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) of a [Presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) cannot be uniquely derived from the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) available at that level, it is assumed not to be [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12). It is not a theorem.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 經驗禁止是從案例中提煉出的必要條件：缺少某個條件時，某個結局[不會發生](concepts.md#c01)。它不是由框架推出，而是由跨案例的校準得來，必須標明，並可以被新的案例修改。它只寫必要條件，不寫充分條件：條件都滿足時，也只能說那個結局的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)變重。
definition_en: An empirical prohibition is a necessary condition distilled from cases: without a certain condition, a certain outcome [Never Occurs](concepts.md#c01). It is not derived from the framework but obtained by calibration across cases, so it must be marked as such and may be revised by new cases. It states only necessary conditions, never sufficient ones: even when all the conditions are met, one can only say that the [Weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) of that outcome has become heavier.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 持平是[耦合](concepts.md#c36)之下的一種走向：在一個講明的維度上，參與者[輸出](concepts.md#c28)的模式之間的距離不變。
definition_en: Stasis is one direction of development under [Coupling](concepts.md#c36): along a stated dimension, the distance between the patterns of the participants' [Outputs](concepts.md#c28) stays the same.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 一次[寫入](concepts.md#c09)中落在一個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)身上的部分，以及落在它身上的[坍塌](concepts.md#c07)結果，都是它收到的刺激。也就是說，刺激是這個[呈現](concepts.md#c04)所處的物理條件的改變，不論來自外界還是它自己；自己或別人作出的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，落在它身上時，也算在內。
definition_en: The part of a [Writing](concepts.md#c09) that falls on a [Presentation](concepts.md#c04), and the outcome of a [Collapse](concepts.md#c07) that falls on it, are both stimuli it receives. In other words, a stimulus is a change in the physical conditions the [presentation](concepts.md#c04) is in, whether it comes from outside or from the presentation itself; [distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) made by itself or by others are included when they fall on it.

paper_title: 四條律相關工具及範例
definition: 復原是讓一個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)[自己的那一段](concepts.md#c16)，整段再發生一次。也就是說，它的一切物理狀態，時間逆流，回到過去的某一個[時刻](concepts.md#c08)。
definition_en: Restoration is making the whole of a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)'s [Own Segment](concepts.md#c16) happen once again. In other words, all of its physical states flow back in time to some past [Moment](concepts.md#c08).

paper_title: 生物人輸出格局動力學
definition: 研究者為某個要追蹤的結構（例如[人群圖](concepts.md#c05)、[經濟模式](concepts.md#c09)）講明的判準，用來判定它在各個[檢查窗口](concepts.md#c03)中是否再次出現，包括[同一性條件](concepts.md#c02)與[檢查窗口](concepts.md#c03)兩部分。判準是研究者的定義；是否再次出現是該[檢查窗口](concepts.md#c03)實際發生的事實，兩者不互相替代。
definition_en: A criterion that a researcher states for a structure to be tracked (for example a [Population Graph](concepts.md#c05) or an [Economic Mode](concepts.md#c09)), used to decide whether it appears again in each [check window](concepts.md#c03). It has two parts: an [Identity Condition](concepts.md#c02) and a [Check Window](concepts.md#c03). The criterion is the researcher's definition; whether the structure actually reappears in a [check window](concepts.md#c03) is a fact, and neither replaces the other.
