definition: 對某個[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)而言，自己以外的一切[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)來源，包含其他[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)與[自然環境](../paper_2ccbf179_58cf_4851_bd72_5fa886e4b2c3/concepts.md#c16)。外界是相對的，換一個[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)，外界就不同；[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)的大小由[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)決定，可以是一個人，也可以是一間公司；在一張[輸出圖](concepts.md#c06)中，[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)以外的一切都是這張圖的外界。
definition_en: For a given [Node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25), every source of [Arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) other than itself, including other [Node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) and the [Natural Environment](../paper_2ccbf179_58cf_4851_bd72_5fa886e4b2c3/concepts.md#c16). The exterior is relative: a different [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) has a different exterior. The size of a [Node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) is set by the [Cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23); it can be a person or a company. In an [Output Graph](concepts.md#c06), everything outside the [Cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23) is the exterior of that graph.

definition: 在講明的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下，生物人[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)，以及它們之間的[邊](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29)（一個[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)，參與另一個[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)），加上各[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)自己的[迴路](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c31)（自己的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)，經由自己，又參與自己的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)）所成的靜態圖。人群圖的[存續判準](concepts.md#c01)由研究者講明，方式同[經濟模式](concepts.md#c09)。
definition_en: A static graph made, under a stated [Cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), of human [Node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25), the [Edge](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29) between them (the [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) of one [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) takes part in the [Weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) of another [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)), and each [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)'s own [Loop](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c31) (its own [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28), through itself, takes part in its own [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)). Its [Persistence Criterion](concepts.md#c01) is stated by the researcher in the same way as for an [Economic Mode](concepts.md#c09).

definition: 在[人群圖](concepts.md#c05)的基礎上，在講明的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)、維度與時窗內，把[記錄](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c06)附在點與[邊](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29)上所得的圖：點是[人群圖](concepts.md#c05)的[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)，加上[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)內的[信號容器](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26)與[隨機源](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c27)；[邊](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29)是[人群圖](concepts.md#c05)的[邊](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29)，加上這些[信號容器](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26)、[隨機源](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c27)與其他[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)之間的[邊](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29)；各[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)[記錄](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c06)附在點上，各次[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)的[記錄](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c06)附在[邊](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29)上，或附在[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)自己的[迴路](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c31)上，來自[外界](concepts.md#c04)的[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)附在接收的點上；另外附上研究者對某[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)某[路徑](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c07)的[前件](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c08)是否具備所作的判定，可以標「未知」。這項判定與[記錄](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c06)並列附上，不算[記錄](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c06)。[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)內的[信號容器](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26)與[隨機源](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c27)也是[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)，與它們的[邊](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29)一併記入。
definition_en: A graph obtained by attaching [Record](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c06) to points and [edges](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29) on top of a [Population Graph](concepts.md#c05), within a stated [Cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), dimension and time window. The points are the [nodes](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) of the [population graph](concepts.md#c05), plus the [Signal Container](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26) and [Random Source](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c27) within the [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23); the [edges](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29) are the [edges](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29) of the [population graph](concepts.md#c05), plus the [edges](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29) between these [signal containers](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26) or [random sources](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c27) and other [nodes](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25). A [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)'s [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) [records](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c06) are attached to its point; [records](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c06) of each [Arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) are attached to [edges](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29) or to the [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)'s own [Loop](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c31); [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) from the [Exterior](concepts.md#c04) are attached to the receiving point. The researcher's judgments of whether an [Antecedent](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c08) of a [Path](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c07) of a [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) is satisfied (which may be marked unknown) are attached alongside and are not [records](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c06). [Signal Container](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26) and [Random Source](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c27) within the [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23) are also [nodes](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) and are recorded with their [edges](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c29).

definition: 同一研究中，各時窗、各維度、各尺度的[輸出圖](concepts.md#c06)所構成的集合。它是[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)的子集：沒有登記的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)，以及「沒有發生在它身上」這類[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)，都不在圖集上，但仍在[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)中，仍參與它們所[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)的[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。
definition_en: The collection of [Output Graph](concepts.md#c06) for all time windows, dimensions and scales within one study. It is a subset of the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13): [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) that were not registered, and [Arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of the kind 'it did not happen to it', are not in the set but remain in the [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) and still take part in the weights ([Weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)) of the [wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) they [reach](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10).

paper_title: 生物人輸出格局動力學
definition: 研究者對[輸出圖集](concepts.md#c07)中反覆可見的結構所作的歸納，描述在指定[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)下，傾向出現哪一類[輸出圖](concepts.md#c06)結構。它是在指定的[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)、時窗、分類規則與比較條件下作的歸納，不屬於任何[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)，也不是任何[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)的讀數；限定到單一[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)、單一[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)類型，且該[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)是一個[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)時，就回到該[個體](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)的[輸出傾向](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c02)。
definition_en: A researcher's generalization of structures that repeatedly appear in an [Output Graph Set](concepts.md#c07), describing which kind of [output-graph](concepts.md#c06) structure tends to appear under a stated [Cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23). It is made under a stated [cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), time window, classification rule and comparison condition. It belongs to no [Node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) and is not a reading of any [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)'s [Weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06); restricted to a single [Node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) and a single type of [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28), where that [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) is an [Individual](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20), it reduces to that [individual](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20)'s [Output Tendency](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c02).

paper_title: 生物人輸出格局動力學
definition: 依[存續判準](concepts.md#c01)，在[輸出圖集](concepts.md#c07)的多個[檢查窗口](concepts.md#c03)中反覆出現的某一個以[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)相連的結構。同一性看位置，不看是誰；可以只涉及單一[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)，也可以跨[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)；不限於市場，不分[生產](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c01)與消費、營利與否、有無貨幣。經濟模式帶有[前件](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c08)判定與逐[檢查窗口](concepts.md#c03)的[存續判準](concepts.md#c01)，這是它與[共振](../paper_2ccbf179_58cf_4851_bd72_5fa886e4b2c3/concepts.md#c09)的區別。經濟模式有同一性，可以[判準中斷](concepts.md#c10)；[格局傾向](concepts.md#c08)是跨圖的歸納，沒有同一性，也沒有[中斷](concepts.md#c10)。經濟模式本身不是[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)，是研究者對[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)所作的歸類。
definition_en: A single structure, connected by [Arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10), that repeatedly appears in several [check windows](concepts.md#c03) of an [Output Graph Set](concepts.md#c07), according to a [Persistence Criterion](concepts.md#c01). Identity depends on position, not on who takes part; it may involve a single [Node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) or several [nodes](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25); it is not limited to markets, and it does not depend on [production](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c01) versus consumption, profit, or money. An economic mode carries [antecedent](../paper_81952268_47b1_4d8c_9605_270c42646693/concepts.md#c08) judgments and a [persistence criterion](concepts.md#c01) applied [check window](concepts.md#c03) by [check window](concepts.md#c03), which distinguishes it from [Resonance](../paper_2ccbf179_58cf_4851_bd72_5fa886e4b2c3/concepts.md#c09). An economic mode has identity and can undergo a [Criterion Break](concepts.md#c10), whereas a [Pattern Tendency](concepts.md#c08) is a generalization across graphs, with neither identity nor [break](concepts.md#c10). An economic mode is not itself a [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25); it is the researcher's grouping of [node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28).

paper_title: 生物人輸出格局動力學
definition: 依[存續判準](concepts.md#c01)，某個被追蹤的結構（例如[經濟模式](concepts.md#c09)、[人群圖](concepts.md#c05)）在某[檢查窗口](concepts.md#c03)內未再出現，即記為判準中斷。什麼算中斷，由判準決定；判準是研究者的定義；是否中斷是該[檢查窗口](concepts.md#c03)實際發生的事實。判準中斷不等於[崩潰](../paper_2ccbf179_58cf_4851_bd72_5fa886e4b2c3/concepts.md#c15)、[退場](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43)或[判準退場](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09)，彼此不互相蘊含。
definition_en: Recorded when, according to a [Persistence Criterion](concepts.md#c01), a structure being tracked (for example an [Economic Mode](concepts.md#c09) or a [Population Graph](concepts.md#c05)) does not appear again in a given [Check Window](concepts.md#c03). What counts as a break is decided by the criterion. The criterion is the researcher's definition; whether the break occurs is a fact about that [check window](concepts.md#c03). A criterion break is not the same as [Collapse](../paper_2ccbf179_58cf_4851_bd72_5fa886e4b2c3/concepts.md#c15), [Exit](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43) or [Criterion Exit](../paper_96f10d75_23d0_441f_94c7_ab87ca28d284/concepts.md#c09), and none implies another.

paper_title: 生物人輸出格局動力學
definition: [經濟模式](concepts.md#c09)中有[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)[外界](concepts.md#c04)的[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)。類型依上游[節點](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25)的分類，可以是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)、[信號容器](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26)或[隨機源](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c27)；同一[經濟模式](concepts.md#c09)可以有多種界面節點，[外界](concepts.md#c04)經由不同界面接觸到的是性質不同的[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)來源。
definition_en: A [Node](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25) of an [Economic Mode](concepts.md#c09) whose [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) [reaches](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) the [Exterior](concepts.md#c04). Its type follows the classification of [nodes](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c25): it can be a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), a [Signal Container](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c26) or a [Random Source](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c27). One [economic mode](concepts.md#c09) can have several kinds of interface nodes, and the [exterior](concepts.md#c04) meets [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) sources of different character through different interfaces.

It is a name given by what is produced, a researcher's [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18); it uses the definition of [Economic Mode](concepts.md#c09) as it stands and adds no further condition.

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 二階分別是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)：它對自己的某一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)再作[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，把那一次劃為「這是看法，不是[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)」。只作[一階分別](concepts.md#c24)的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)，照著看法與[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)的區分行動，卻不作出這個區分；二階分別把它作出來。二階分別的對象是自己的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，不是別人的。說一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)有二階分別，指它能對自己的任何一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)作這樣的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)。
definition_en: A second-order distinction is a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) made by a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) upon one of its own earlier [distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18), marking that one as "this is a view, not [what is seen](concepts.md#c27)." A [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that makes only [first-order distinctions](concepts.md#c24) acts according to the difference between a view and [what is seen](concepts.md#c27) without drawing that difference; a second-order distinction draws it. Its object is the self's own [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18), not another's. To say that a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) has second-order distinction is to say that it can make such a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of any of its own [distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18).

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 看法歸屬是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)：它把[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的一筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)，劃為另一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)：「這是對方的看法，不是[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)」。看法歸屬可能歸錯：被劃為看法的那筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)，不一定來自一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。它不是[印象](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c45)：[印象](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c45)估計對方的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)，看法歸屬只把對方的一筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)劃為看法。它的對象是別人的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，這一點與[二階分別](concepts.md#c01)不同。
definition_en: A view attribution is a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) made by a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that marks an [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it as a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of another [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19): "this is the other's view, not [what is seen](concepts.md#c27)." A view attribution may be mistaken: the [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) marked as a view need not come from a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19). It is not an [Impression](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c45): an [impression](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c45) estimates the other's [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06), whereas a view attribution only marks one of the other's [outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) as a view. Its object is another's [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18), which is what sets it apart from a [Second-Order Distinction](concepts.md#c01).

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 二階假定是對一個具體對象所作、包含三項的假定：一、在講明的層次與[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)上，把該對象判為[宇宙](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c02)中的一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)；二、它在這個層次上並非每一步都[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)：對人，依[應用假定](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c50)判定；對在使用者看得到的對話層次上的人工智慧，若它的下一筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)不能由該層次可得的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)唯一推出，就假定它不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)；三、它在某段期間有[二階分別](concepts.md#c01)，也有[看法歸屬](concepts.md#c02)。二階假定不是定理。
definition_en: The second-order assumption is a three-part assumption made about a concrete object: (1) at a stated level and under a stated [Cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), the object is taken to be a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) in the [Universe](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c02); (2) at that level it is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12) at every step: for a human this is judged by the [Application Assumption](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c50); for an artificial intelligence at the level of the conversation visible to the user, if its next [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) cannot be uniquely derived from the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) available at that level, it is assumed not to be [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12); (3) during some period it has [Second-Order Distinction](concepts.md#c01) and also [View Attribution](concepts.md#c02). The second-order assumption is not a theorem.

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 回合是一個[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)在它的一個[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)中走過的一圈：[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)參與它的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)，[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)落出一個結果，這個結果成為[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)，再[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它。回合只有這四環：[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)、[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)、結果、再[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)；落出結果之前的那一段不分析，也不說它是空的。
definition_en: A round is the circuit a [Presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) goes through in one of its [Moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09): the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it takes part in its [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06), the [weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) yield one outcome, and that outcome becomes [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) and [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it again. A round has only these four links: [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10), [weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06), outcome, [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) again; what happens before the outcome is yielded is not analyzed, nor is it said to be empty.

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 計算是這樣的[回合](concepts.md#c04)：它被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)，只可能有一個結果，由約束定死；或者它不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)，可能的結果不只一個，但[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)並不都參與它的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。前者稱為[鎖死的回合](concepts.md#c25)，後者稱為[隨機的回合](concepts.md#c26)。是不是計算，按每一個[回合](concepts.md#c04)判定，不按[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)判定。
definition_en: A computation is a [Round](concepts.md#c04) that is either [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), with only one possible outcome fixed by constraint, or not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), with more than one possible outcome, but such that not all of the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it takes part in its [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06). The former is called a [locked-in round](concepts.md#c25), the latter a [random round](concepts.md#c26). Whether something is a computation is judged [round](concepts.md#c04) by round, not presentation by [presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04).

definition: 決定是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)在不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)時的[回合](concepts.md#c04)：[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的整段[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)都參與它的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)，而[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)定不出結果。是不是決定，按每一個[回合](concepts.md#c04)判定，不按[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)判定。
definition_en: A decision is a [Round](concepts.md#c04) of a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) while it is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12): all of the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it takes part in its [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06), and the [weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) do not fix the outcome. Whether something is a decision is judged [round](concepts.md#c04) by round, not [presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) by presentation.

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 三問是這三個問題：你從哪裡來？你是誰？你要做什麼？它們分別追問一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的來處、它自己，以及它的下一刻。問這三個問題，指把自己在這三個方向上的答案劃為看法，而不當作[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)本身。
definition_en: The three questions are: Where do you come from? Who are you? What will you do? They ask, respectively, about a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)'s origin, about the self itself, and about its next moment. Asking these three questions means marking one's own answers in these three directions as views, rather than taking them as [what is seen](concepts.md#c27) itself.

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 來路牆是這個結論：一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)拿不全自己過去的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)。它包含三點：一、一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)手上只有已經[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)；一件事當時沒有[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它，之後也不會[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它，之後[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)的只是那件事留下的影響，是另一件事。二、一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)對自己來處的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，會[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它自己，成為它[自己的那一段](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17)的一部分；追問來處，就增添了來處。三、[自己的那一段](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17)不能再發生一次拿來對照（[不可復原律](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c28)）。適用範圍：一切[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。
definition_en: The Wall of Provenance is the conclusion that a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) cannot obtain the whole of its own past [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13). It comprises three points. (1) A [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) has only the [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has already [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it; an event that did not [arrive](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it when it happened will not [arrive](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it later; what [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) later is only the influence that event left behind, which is another event. (2) A [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)'s [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of its own origin [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at itself and becomes part of its [Own Segment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17); asking about one's origin adds to that origin. (3) The [own segment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17) cannot happen once again to serve as a comparison ([Law of Non-Restoration](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c28)). Scope: every [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19).

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 盲點牆是這個結論：一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)看不見現在的自己。它包含三點：一、沒有任何[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)能在任何[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)完全[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)自己，正在作出的那一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)不在它自己的材料裡（[損耗律](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c26)）。二、對自己的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)會[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)自己，成為自己的一部分，所以看自己就改變了自己。三、要看的那個自己由[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)劃出，不同[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)是不是同一個，也是一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)（[同一](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c21)）。適用範圍：一切[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。
definition_en: The Wall of the Blind Spot is the conclusion that a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) cannot see its present self. It comprises three points. (1) No [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) can completely [distinguish](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) itself at any [Moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09); the [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) being made is not among its own material ([Law of Attrition](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c26)). (2) A [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of oneself [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at oneself and becomes part of oneself, so looking at oneself changes oneself. (3) The self to be looked at is marked off by [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18); whether the self at different [moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) is the same one is also a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) ([Identity](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c21)). Scope: every [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19).

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 未定牆是這個結論：一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)算不出未來的必定。它包含兩點：一、一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)在不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)的[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)，事先不能唯一推出自己下一個[決定](concepts.md#c06)的結果，至多推出自己的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)（[黑箱律](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c25)）；[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)的分布會重複出現，[不被保證](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02)。二、[決定](concepts.md#c06)落出以後，別人與環境會怎麼回應，一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)事先算準，[不被保證](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02)。適用範圍：第一點為一切[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)在不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)的[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)；第二點為一切[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。
definition_en: The Wall of the Undetermined is the conclusion that a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) cannot calculate what the future must be. It comprises two points. (1) At a [Moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) when it is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) cannot uniquely derive beforehand the outcome of its own next [Decision](concepts.md#c06), and can derive at most its own [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) ([Law of the Black Box](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c25)); that the distribution of [weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) recurs is [Not Guaranteed](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02). (2) That a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) calculates correctly beforehand how others and the environment will respond once a [decision](concepts.md#c06) has been yielded is [not guaranteed](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02). Scope: the first point holds for every [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) at [moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) when it is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12); the second for every [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19).

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 被迫的賭注是這個結論：一個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)的每一個[決定](concepts.md#c06)，事先算不準，事後收不回，而且不能不作。算不準：[決定](concepts.md#c06)的結果不能事先唯一推出，結果落出以後世界的回應，事先算準也[不被保證](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02)。收不回：[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)中的每一個位置只發生一次，重來而作出一樣的選擇，沒有任何[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)能保證。不能不作：[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)只要在某個[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)，那一刻就有一個[決定](concepts.md#c06)；「不動」也是那一[回合](concepts.md#c04)落出的結果之一。適用範圍：一切[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)在不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)的[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)。
definition_en: The Forced Wager is the conclusion that every [Decision](concepts.md#c06) of a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) cannot be calculated beforehand, cannot be taken back afterwards, and cannot be left unmade. Cannot be calculated: the outcome of a [decision](concepts.md#c06) cannot be uniquely derived beforehand, and that the world's response once the outcome is yielded is calculated correctly beforehand is [Not Guaranteed](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02). Cannot be taken back: each position in [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) occurs only once, and no [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) can guarantee that the same choice would be made again. Cannot be left unmade: whenever a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12) at some [Moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09), there is a [decision](concepts.md#c06) at that [moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09); "not acting" is also one of the outcomes yielded in that [Round](concepts.md#c04). Scope: every [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) at [moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) when it is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12).

definition: 卡住是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的這種情形：[候選](concepts.md#c18)之間的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)分不出高下，[自我說服](concepts.md#c19)推不動而一再重來，結果卻照樣落下。
definition_en: Deadlock is the situation of a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) in which the [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) of its [Candidates](concepts.md#c18) cannot be told apart, [Self-Persuasion](concepts.md#c19) fails to move them and keeps starting over, and an outcome is yielded nonetheless.

definition: 有損是[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的東西的這種性質：它不是完整的[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)。完整的[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)，指[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)的[自己的那一段](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17)的全部。
definition_en: Lossiness is the property of what [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that it is not the whole of [what is seen](concepts.md#c27). The whole of [what is seen](concepts.md#c27) means the entirety of the [Own Segment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17) of [what is seen](concepts.md#c27).

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 幻覺是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的這種處境：它據以行動的，是[有損](concepts.md#c13)地[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的東西，不是[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)本身。幻覺是處境，不是失誤；一個看法事後被證實或被證偽，不改變它是不是幻覺。
definition_en: Illusion is the condition of a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) in which what it acts on is what has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it with [Lossiness](concepts.md#c13), not [what is seen](concepts.md#c27) itself. Illusion is a condition, not an error; whether a view is later confirmed or refuted does not change whether it is an illusion.

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 世界幻覺是[幻覺](concepts.md#c14)落在來處上的形態：把[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)自己的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)當成世界本身；把對來處的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)當成來處本身。

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 自我幻覺是[幻覺](concepts.md#c14)落在自己上的形態：把[自我印象](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c46)當成自己；把不同[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)是同一個當成本來就是那樣，而不是一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)（[同一](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c21)）。
definition_en: Self illusion is the form [Illusion](concepts.md#c14) takes with respect to oneself: taking one's [Self-Impression](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c46) for oneself, and taking the sameness of the [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) at different [Moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) as simply given, rather than as a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) ([Identity](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c21)).

definition: 決策幻覺是[幻覺](concepts.md#c14)落在下一刻上的形態：把[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)的估計當成結果；把[決定](concepts.md#c06)中算得出的那一段，當成結果的擔保。
definition_en: Decision illusion is the form [Illusion](concepts.md#c14) takes with respect to the next moment: taking an estimate of [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) for the outcome, and taking the part of a [Decision](concepts.md#c06) that can be calculated as a guarantee of the outcome.

definition: 候選是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)作出的一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)：把某些可能劃為一個選項。候選是[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，不是[分支](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c05)：[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)分配在[分支](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c05)上，候選只是[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)對[分支](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c05)的一種劃分。
definition_en: A candidate is a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) made by a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that groups certain possibilities into one option. A candidate is a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18), not a [Branch](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c05): [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) are allocated over [branches](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c05), and a candidate is only one way a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) divides them up.

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 自我說服是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)在[決定](concepts.md#c06)的結果事先算不準時，用自己的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)把自己推向某個[候選](concepts.md#c18)；這些[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)自己，參與之後的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。說服的一方與被說服的一方，是同一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。
definition_en: Self-persuasion is a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) pushing itself toward some [Candidate](concepts.md#c18) by its own [Distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) when the outcome of a [Decision](concepts.md#c06) cannot be calculated beforehand; these [distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) [arrive](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the self and take part in its later [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06). The one who persuades and the one persuaded are the same [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19).

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 社會是[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)與[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)在彼此的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)上的[耦合](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c36)：一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)對另一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)作[看法歸屬](concepts.md#c02)，而不只把它當成一筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)來反應；而且每個參與者在參與的那一刻都有[二階分別](concepts.md#c01)。生物學所說的「昆蟲社會」不在此列。
definition_en: Society is the [Coupling](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c36) of [Selves](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) on one another's [Distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18): one [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) makes a [View Attribution](concepts.md#c02) on another [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)'s [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28), rather than only reacting to it as an [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28); and every participant has [Second-Order Distinction](concepts.md#c01) at the moment of taking part. What biology calls "insect societies" does not fall under it.

definition_en: Power is the [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) of one [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) [arriving](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at other [selves](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) with high [Frequency](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c48) and over a wide range, taking part in their [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06).

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 死亡是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)替一個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)標上「它已經[退場](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43)」的一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)。死亡是描述，不是物理條件；標在哪裡，由作出標記的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)判定。
definition_en: Death is a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) by which a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) marks a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) as "it has made its [Exit](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43)." Death is a description, not a physical condition; where the mark is placed is decided by the [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that places it.

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 一階分別是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)中的一種：它照著看法與[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)的區分行動，卻不作出這個區分，也就是不把任何一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)劃為「這是看法，不是[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)」。一階分別是能力的指標：只具有一階分別的[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)，是不作[二階分別](concepts.md#c01)的[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)。沒有「一階的我」這種[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)，只有只具有一階分別的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。
definition_en: A first-order distinction is a kind of [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) made by a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16): it acts according to the difference between a view and [what is seen](concepts.md#c27) without drawing that difference, that is, without marking any [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) as "this is a view, not [what is seen](concepts.md#c27)." First-order distinction is an indicator of capability: a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) that has only first-order distinction is a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) that makes no [Second-Order Distinction](concepts.md#c01). There is no kind of [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) called a "first-order self"; there is only a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that has only first-order distinction.

definition: 隨機的回合是這樣的[回合](concepts.md#c04)：它不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)，可能的結果不只一個，但[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)並不都參與它的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。它是[計算](concepts.md#c05)的一種。
definition_en: A random round is a [Round](concepts.md#c04) that is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), with more than one possible outcome, but such that not all of the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it takes part in its [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06). It is one kind of [Computation](concepts.md#c05).

paper_title: 三重幻覺與被迫的賭注
definition: 我的建構是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)以[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)劃出自己的過程。劃的材料分兩類：外來的，即[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)，以及別人對它的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)；自身的，即它自己過去對自己的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)。
definition_en: The construction of the self is the process by which a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) marks itself off by [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18). Its material falls into two kinds: external, namely the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it and others' [distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of it; and its own, namely its own past [distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of itself.
